https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of an Astronomical Body's Orbit around the Sun.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nuclear Weapon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a destructive nuclear reaction, either through fission or through a combination of fission and fusion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Momentum
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile of an object in Motion that is the product of its Mass and Velocity with respect to a frame of reference.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Enemy Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent having committed offensive Acts or exhibited intent to perform such Acts towards a particular Agent or Group of Agents or has been declared as hostile by some appropriate authority.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Torpedo
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Precision-Guided Missile that is designed to be fired into a body of water, be self-propelled through the water, and carry an explosive payload.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Albedo
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of its surface to reflect incident electromagnetic radiation of a particular wavelength.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Counterfeit Financial Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some legally sanctioned Financial Instrument.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cylindrical
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an elongated shape with round bases.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Strength
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Emergency Locator Transmitter
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Transmitter that is designed to signal distress and provide positional data for the entity it is located on.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Partially Mission Capable Maintenance
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Partially Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing some of its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Inertial Navigation System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Navigation System that is designed to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to supply power to some other Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radar Imaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using radio waves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Decoy Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Decoy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity which designates some Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that classifies Entities according to some shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristic.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Air-Breathing Jet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Jet Engine that is propelled by a jet of hot exhaust gases formed from air that is drawn into the Engine via an Air Inlet.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wetness
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Angular Velocity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Velocity that is characterized by both the angular Speed of an object and the Axis about which the object is Rotating.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Hydrosphere
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A fiat object part of the combined mass of water found on, under, and above the surface of a natural satellite.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to be small enough to be carried by a single person and fired while supported on the person's shoulder.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prosthetic Leg
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing leg.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Group of Agents
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Object Aggregate that has only Agents as member parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vehicle Transmission
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Power Transmission Artifact that is designed to vary the output speed and torque in a rotating power transfer system.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Alternating Current Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of alternating current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Intercommunication System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable some Act of Communication between end points within a building, small collection of buildings, or within a small area of service.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Microscope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to enable users to see Objects that are otherwise too small to be seen by the naked eye by producing a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sound Pressure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Pressure that is caused by a Sound Wave and is a local deviation from the ambient Pressure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hinge
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Machine Bearing that is designed to limit the angle of Rotation between two solid objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Food
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that is designed to be consumed and ingested for nutrition or taste.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Military Service
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Employment by an Organization wherein a Person serves as a member of a Military Force, whether voluntarily or by conscription.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Healthcare Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of treating and preventing illness.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Grenade
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be relatively small and to be thrown by hand.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Filtration Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Filter Function that is realized in a process in which some solid entity is prevented from moving along with some quantity of liquid.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Propulsion Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process in which one or more Forces are generated and applied to a participating Object such that the Object is set in Motion or has the direction or magnitude of its Motion altered.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wavelength
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the distance the Wave Process traverses during one Wave Cycle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Information Quality Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that concretizes some Information Content Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Switching Node
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that is capable of redirecting a communication transmission to another Telecommunication Network Node.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Liquid Helium
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid helium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electronic Signal Processing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Signal Processing Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to process or transfer information contained in electronic signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Disease
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Design
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that is a specification of an object, manifested by an agent, intended to accomplish goals, in a particular environment, using a set of primitive components, satisfying a set of requirements, subject to constraints.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Reconnaissance
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering used to determine an Agent's disposition and intention; the composition and capabilities of Equipment and Facilities, and the surrounding landforms and weather conditions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Residential Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of residing in a dwelling or home.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Funding
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use in which an Agent (the Funder) provides some Financial Instrument to another Agent (the recipient of the funds) as a resource pool that is earmarked by the Funder for a future transaction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Function that inheres in some Material Artifact in virtue of that Material Artifact being designed to be used in processes that require that Function to be realized.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Width
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Transponder
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that acts as both a Radio Transmitter and responder and is used to wirelessly receive and transmit electrical signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Texture
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on its surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Transportation Infrastructure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Infrastructure System that has continuant part one or more Transportation Artifacts and bears a function that, if realized, is realized in Acts of Cargo Transportation

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Multi-Month Temporal Interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Months and spans at least one Month.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thermal Power Plant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert heat energy into electrical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: House
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to provide a self-standing, permanent residence for an individual, family, household, multiple families, or similar-sized group.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Training Camp
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for rigorous and focused training in order to learn or improve skills, usually involving physical actions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gas Turbine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that has a rotating compressor and a turbine and is designed to operate utilizing continous Combustion to produce Thrust, either directly via exhaust or indirectly via a prop.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Interphone
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Intercommunication System that that is designed to facilitate some Act of Communication between agents by means of audio messages.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis in which some Independent Continuant bears some Generically Dependent Continuant that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Apartment Building
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to contain multiple permanent residences comprised of a suite of rooms.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rocket-Propelled Grenade
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Unguided Rocket that is designed to contain an explosive warhead, be fired from a Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher, and be used against Tanks.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fan
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of a rotating arrangement of vanes or blades that are designed to act on a portion of fluid to create flow within it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Agricultural Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed as a building or campus for agricultural processes with the aim of cultivating animals, plants, or fungi for food, fiber, biofuel, medicinal plants, or other products to sustain and enhance human life.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mortar
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Cannon that is designed to fire projectiles at relatively low velocities over relatively short ranges.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prosthetic Arm
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing arm.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Brake
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to inhibit the Vehicle's Motion by absorbing energy from a moving system.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reciprocating Steam Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to use one or more reciprocating pistons to convert pressure into a rotating motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Surfactant Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Emulsifier Artifact Function that is realized in a process that lowers the surface tension between two liquids or between a liquid and a solid.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Measuring
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act that involves determining the extent, dimensions, quanity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate communication between at least two entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electronic Bond
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bond that consists of Bytes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Filter
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that bears a Filter Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Police Station
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Public Safety Facility that is designed for the professional and clerical processes of a local police force.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cooling System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to cool the air or objects in a Site.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Commanding
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Directive Communication through which an Agent exercises authoritative control or power over another Agent's actions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Satellite Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spacecraft that is designed to Orbit a Space Object (typically Earth).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Research Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to perform research on a specified entity or class of entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Testifying
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by stating one's personal knowledge or belief.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Refracting Optical Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light via refraction through the use of one or more Lenses to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Article
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Publishing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, journal, etc.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act by which an Agent causes the position or location of some Object to change.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Region Bounding Box
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Polygon that is a boundary of some Geospatial Region that has another Geospatial Region as a non-tangential proper part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Julian Date
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Time of Day as specified according to the Julian Calendar using the Julian Date epoch.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wounded Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Damaged Stasis in which a Person or other organism is the bearer of a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to an injuring event.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Increase of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Function that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rocket Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Jet Engine that is designed to use only stored Rocket Propellant to form a high speed propulsive jet in order to generate Thrust.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wireless Telecommunication Network
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Network that uses wireless connections to connect Telecommunication Network Nodes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pneumatic Motor
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts potential energy stored in a portion of compressed air into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: x-Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'x'.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Information Processing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which one or more input Information Content Entities are received, manipulated, transferred, or stored by an Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Military Training Instruction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Military Organization by imparting knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rotational Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Motion Process in which an Object moves in a Circular or Elliptical Path around an Axis of Rotation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Priority Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the relative importance of an entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Condoling
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing sympathy or sorrow.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Prediction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act that involves the generation of a Predictive Information Content entity that is intended to describe an uncertain possible future event, value, entity, or attribute of an entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Transformer Rectifier Unit
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to perform the functions of both a Rectifier and a Transformer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Position
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fiat Point that is at or near the surface of the Earth and fixed according to some Geospatial Coordinate Reference System.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Volumetric Flow Rate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit of Flow that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which volumes of fluid pass per unit time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Warehouse
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store commercial goods.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Gallium Arsenide
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Material that is composed of a compound of the elements gallium and arsenic.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Disability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality inhering in an Agent by virtue a physical or mental condition that limits the Agent's movements, senses, or activities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Color
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's Color Hue, Color Saturation and Color Brightness.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Representative Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication that commits a speaker to the truth of the expressed content.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pressure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Force that is applied perpendicular to the surface of an Object per unit area over which that Force is distributed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Weapon Manufacturing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Factory that is designed to produce or assemble weapons.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Spreadsheet
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some Information Content Entity in an interactive, tabular form.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nuclear Family
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Family composed of parents and their children.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rectilinear Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a straight path.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wide
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly larger in proportion to its length or height.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Webcast
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source that may be distributed live or on demand.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Axis of Rotation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region defined by the line around which a spinning body rotates.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Citizen
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Citizen Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Buying
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Buyer) to acquire ownership of a good from another Agent (the Seller).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spatial Region Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Spatial Region.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Tremendously High Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 GHz and 3 THz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Allegiance Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of the support it has committed to provide to another Agent when that Agent is involved in a conflict.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Yaw Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the top to the bottom and is perpendicular to the direction of the object's motion. For objects in Orbit, the Yaw Axis passes through the Barycenter of its Orbit.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Internal Combustion Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an internal Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy that is then converted into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Extremely Low Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Combustion Chamber
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to wholly or partially bound an internal Site where a Combustion process is intended to occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reference System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes a set of standards for organizing and understanding data of the specified type or domain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Temporal Region Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Temporal Region.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Park
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature that is a bounded area of land, or water, usually in its natural or semi-natural (landscaped) state and set aside for some purpose, usually to do with recreation or conservation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fundamental Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Frequency that is the lowest Frequency of a Sound Wave.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which the objective is to create a concretization of some Information Content Entity in one or more recipients.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Diffraction Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a diffraction event in which the Material Artifact forces a wave to bend around the corners of an obstacle or aperture into the region of geometrical shadow of the obstacle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Iris
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the part of an Eye that is a pigmented, round, contractile membrane, suspended between the cornea and lens and perforated by the pupil, and which canonically regulates the amount of light entering the Eye.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Second-Order Administrative Region
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a First-Order Administrative Region.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit specifying the geospatial coordinates of a location.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electrical Resistance Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Material Artifact opposes the flow of an electric current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization that is part of a Government and is responsible for the oversight or administration of specific governmental functions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spark Ignition System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to produce a spark in order to initiate an Ignition process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Residential Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to house one or more Persons.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Speed Measurement Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Speed of a specified object's or class of objects' Motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Oxidizer Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which electrons are removed from a reactant in a redox reaction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electron Microscope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use a beam of accelerated electrons to illuminate the target and produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Square Waveform
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a square shape due to the near-instantaneous transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Anti-Microbial Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a microorganism.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Press Release
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Publishing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prosthetic Hand
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing hand.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Biographical Life
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act composed of the Life Events that occur during the course of existence of an Agent (i.e. Person or Organization).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Part Number
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a type of part whose instances are designed to be part of some Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Computer
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Processing Artifact that is designed to execute an arbitrary set of arithmetic or logical operations automatically.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nuclear Power Plant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Thermal Power Plant that is designed to produce heat by means of a nuclear reactor, which is then converted to electrical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication Reception Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of receiving information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture automobiles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sharp
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a fine point or thin edge.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gregorian Year
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Calendar Year in the Gregorian Calendar.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Military Personnel Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Armed Force authorized to use deadly force, and weapons, to support the interests of the Government and some or all of its Citizens.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Armored Fighting Vehicle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be armored and used to transport and support military personal in combat missions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Railway Junction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable a Train to switch between the tracks of two routes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stable Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Quality that holds during a Temporal Interval when an object maintains the same Spatial Orientation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: External Combustion Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an external Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy to heat the working fluid, which transfers energy to the Engine where it is converted into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Missile Launch Site
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed for storing and launching missiles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Association
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Social Act wherein an Agent unites with some other Agent in a Planned Act, enterprise or business.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Simple Optical Lens
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Lens consisting of a single piece of transparent material.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gregorian Day
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Calendar Day in the Gregorian Calendar.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: X-ray Microscope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use Electromagnetic Radiation in the soft X-ray band to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Enhancing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of intensifying, increainsg, or further improving the quality, value, or extent of some entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Official Documentation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which an Agent records some information for official use by another Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Black
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that lacks any hues as parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Watercraft
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by water travel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Temperature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its thermal energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radioactive
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer exhibiting or being caused by radioactivity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Commercial Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization that is the bearer of a Commercial Role and whose primary objective is to make a profit from the provision of goods or services.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Energy
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the Amount of work that is available in an object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Weapon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to destroy or inflict damage to structures or systems, or to kill or wound living things by creating specific lethal or nonlethal effects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Circumference
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Perimeter that inheres in a circle or ellipse.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Triangular
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motion Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity changes its position with respect to time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Remuneration
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Employer) to compensate another Agent (the Employee) for the services they perform for the Employer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Silver Color
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that resembles Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Collimation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a collimation event in which the Material Artifact narrows a beam of particles or waves by either causing the spatial cross-section of the beam to become smaller or by causing the directions of motion of the beam's constituents to be aligned in a specifc direction of Motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Timekeeping Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to keep track of and report the current time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Environment Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to control the temperature, air quality, or other feature of a Site that is relevant to the comfort or operation of entities located within that Site.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Compression Ignition System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to generate heat by compressing a portion of fuel and oxidizer mixture in order to initiate an Ignition process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Ceremony
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Social Act of ritual significance, performed on a special occasion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Railway
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Trains to transport passengers and goods.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Material
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that was produced to be used as the input for another Act of Material Artifact Processing.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Coupling
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect two Shafts together at their ends for the purpose of transmitting power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fluorescence
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light while absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, but not after.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Local Administrative Region
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government Domain that delimits a local Government.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Educational Training Instruction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Educational Organization by imparting knowledge of a curriculum to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Oblong
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an long thin shape with approximately parallel sides.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Modified Julian Date
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Time of Day as specified according to the Julian Calendar using the Modified Julian Date epoch.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Orientation Control Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the Orientation of some object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Armored Personnel Carrier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to transport infantry to the battlefield but which are not usually designed to take part in a direct-fire battle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Office Building
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Commercial Facility that is designed as an environment for conducting commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Coordinate Reference System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Reference System that is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Academic Degree
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Certificate that is issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Warning Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Notification Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a possible or impending threat.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Region
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Site that is at or near the surface of the Earth.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fourth-Order Administrative Region
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Curved
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having borders which are smoothly rounded.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Cash
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to be a ready medium of exchange.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Objective
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel Cell
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of an anode, a cathode, and an electrolyte; converts chemical energy from a fuel into electricity through a chemical reaction of positively charged hydrogen ions with an oxidizing agent (typically oxygen); and, if given a continuous source of fuel and oxidizing agent, can continuously produce electricity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cuboidal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having six Rectangular faces.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Public Safety Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for the prevention of and protection from events that could endanger, injure, or damage the general public.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Life Support Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact materially affects an organism, where this causes that organism to continue living in a situation where death would otherwise occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Research and Development Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of producing new knowledge or of devising new applications of existing knowledge.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using the motion of a radar antenna over a targeted region to create a synthetic aperture.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Military Base
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to shelter military equipment and personnel and to facilitate training and operations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Concave Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more cavities, such that at least one line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Commercial Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of its establishment as a for-profit business.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Neutral Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent not performing or being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to either support or undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Location
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Region that is the location of an Independent Continuant (that is not a Spatial Region) or that environs some Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Tripod
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that consists of three legs and a platform that joins them and which is designed to support the weight and maintain the stability of objects that are attached to or rested on the platform.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: High Density Residential Area
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Populated Place which is characterized by densely contained multiple-unit living structures.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: X-ray Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 30 petahertz and 30 exahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Detonating Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of combustion involving a supersonic exothermic front accelerating through a medium that eventually drives a shock front propagating directly in front of it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Email Messaging
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which digital messages are transmitted and received via Internet Message Format-based communication, or an extension thereof, over a computer network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Code List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a List that contains an ordered sequence of Information Bearing Entities that carry Code Identifiers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Serrated
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having multiple sharp points along a edge.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Communication Interference Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Interference Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information via radio waves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Natural Language
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Language that is developed and evolves through use and repetition, rather than through conscious planning or premeditation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of interactions in which the Motion or Velocity of an object is changed, unless the interaction is opposed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Julian Day
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Calendar Day in the Julian Calendar.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wire Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists primarily of a length of wire.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Eye
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent it is part of with the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Financial Withdrawal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent to another Agent (the Depositor) from an account created by an earlier Act of Financial Deposit performed by the Depositor.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Area Moment of Inertia
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the distribution of Mass of an object with respect to an axis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Processing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a visible light processing event.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Contractor Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ethnic Group
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Near Ultraviolet Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 750 terahertz and 3 petahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Service Provider
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mosque
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Islamic worship and prayer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Planning
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act that involves making a Plan to achieve some specified Objective.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiation Emissivity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to emit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Tool Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Tool.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Transverse Wave Profile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is perpendicular to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Vehicle Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pneumatic Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of compressed air or compressed inert gases.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication in which some Material Artifact is used to transfer an Information Bearing Entity from sender(s) to receiver(s).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Currency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit used in measurements of financial values.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Extremely High Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 30 and 300 GHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Departure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the larger Act of Location Change is initiated.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Assassination
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Murder of a prominent person.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pulsejet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that is capable of operating statically and uses intermittent (pulsing) Combustion of the fuel-oxidizer mixture before expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loudness
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the amplitude and total energy of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from soft to loud.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Air Conditioning Unit
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to remove excess heat and humidity from the air in an enclosed space.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Transparent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gamma-ray Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Gamma-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Rotational Inertia
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the distribution of Mass of an object with respect to its axis of rotation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: White
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color of maximum brightness, the color of objects that reflect nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus considered achromatic.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Date Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval Identifier that designates some Day.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sonic Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Frequency that is between 20 Hz and 20 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communications Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to support processes of receiving or transmitting information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government of a Country
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government that has legitimate authority within and is delimited by a Domain of a Country.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Jet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Reaction Engine that discharges a fast moving jet that generates Thrust by jet propulsion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cutting Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired by being opened or divided.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Quality that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bond Certificate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bond that consists of a Certificate.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Financial Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a tradeable asset and that is legally sanctioned.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Defoliant Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Herbicide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes a plant to lose its leaves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Count Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the number of members of some aggregate.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Temporal Instant Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Region Identifier that designates some Temporal Instant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Diameter
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a circle in virtue of the extent of a straight line that passes through the center of the circle and starts and ends on the circle's boundary.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Generically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the carrier of some Generically Dependent Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Disposition it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Target
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that is the object of an Act of Targeting.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Seat of Local Government
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government Building that is designed for the administration of a local community.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Unplanned Act
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act in which at least one Agent plays a causative role and which is not prescribed by some Objective held by any of the Agents.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Electromagnetic Radiation to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vulnerability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Water Transportation Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via water.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Morning
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun dawns (approximately 6:00am) and reaches its apex (approximately 12:00pm).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Organism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Object that is an Animal or Plant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Explosive Weapon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a violent release of energy caused by the exothermic reaction of an explosive material.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Process Prohibition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Change in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Enhanced Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has undergone improvement (i.e., an increase or gain) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of greater value, usefulness, or functionality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Payload
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that is transported by a Vehicle during an Act of Location Change for the purpose of being delivered to or performing one or more functions at a predefined location.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing any of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Visible Light Reflection Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process in which an Electromagnetic Wave with a Visible Light Frequency is reflected off a portion of matter.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cone Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a Round base that tapers smoothly to an apex.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Dam
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to impound surface water or underground streams.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Animal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, heterotrophic, and capable of motility for part of its life.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydrographic Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geographic Feature associated with water.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Educational Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization whose primary purpose is to provide training or otherwise facilitate learning or the acquisition of knowledge, Skills, values, beliefs, or habits.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cube Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Cuboidal shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having six Square faces.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Artifact Employment
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act of using a Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Operational Area
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Location in which an Agent conducts some activity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Organization Capability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sensor
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that bears a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of an object's Momentum, is the product of an object's Mass and Acceleration with respect to an inertial frame of reference, and is measured in units of Newtons (N).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Article of Solid Waste
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Waste Material that has a low liquid content.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sound Production
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Production Process that produces a Sound Wave.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Religious Training Acquisition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Religious Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Environmental Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that is either a natural or man-made feature of the environment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Quality Specification
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Quality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Scalp
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the skin covering the top of the head of a human or other animal.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Rectifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sloped
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thin
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to its length or height.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sine Waveform
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a smooth curved shape due to the continuous non-linear transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Tool
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to assist in the performance of manual or mechanical work and not to be consumed in that process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Hotel that is designed to accommodate motor vehicles along with their occupants.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Position Change
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Motion in which the position (i.e. the orientation, alignment, or arrangement) of some Object or of one or more of an Object's parts is changed by some Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sawtooth Waveform
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from minimum to maximum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the maximum to minimum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Controllable Pitch Propeller
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Propeller whose blades are designed to be alterable by rotating the blades about their vertical axis by means of mechanical or hydraulic arrangement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ally Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent's commitment to perform Acts that support the Objectives of a particular Agent or Group of Agents.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Mass Media Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication intended to reach a large audience using a medium such as the internet, television, radio, newspaper, or magazine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Julian Date Fraction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Julian Day.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Convex Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a cavity, such that no line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Location
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Site that is the location of some Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Propellant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used as an input in a Propulsion Process to produce Thrust.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ignition Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process that initiates a Combustion process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Cargo Transportation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein some Payload is moved from one location to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Instrument Display Panel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry information about some Material Artifact that is derived by the instrumentation Sensors of that Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Valve
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of fluid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing the fluid from moving along a passageway.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Interpersonal Relationship Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person in virtue of the obligations, expectations, or social norms that govern that Person's Intentional Acts within the context of a relationship with another Person.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Legal Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of giving legal advice to clients drafting legal documents for clients and representing clients in legal negotiations and court proceedings such as lawsuits.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Imaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to create one or more new Images.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Navigation Artifact Function
