https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to determine the precise location of itself or another object and plan a route to a specified destination.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Maximum Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of some entity in virtue of it being the largest or having the greatest amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Abbreviated Name
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Name that is a shortened form of a Proper Name.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Truck
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be used to transport cargo.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thickness
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it extending inward through an object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Financial Value
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A quality that inheres in an independent continuant to the degree that that independent continuant can serve as a medium of exchange in an economic system at a particular time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Disposition.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ultraviolet Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 750 terahertz and 30 petahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Realizable Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Weapon Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Weapon.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mass
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the amount of matter in that bearer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Encounter
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons meet in a casual or unplanned manner.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Religion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about the meaning or origin of existence or about the existence or nature of one or more deities, an afterlife, or spiritual or sacred entities, and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrared Camera
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from infrared radiation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ground Vehicle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by some form of ground travel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Week
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to seven consecutive Days.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiopacity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to allow or prevent X-rays to pass through it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Inverse Sawtooth Waveform
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from maximum to minimum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the minimum to maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Fully Mission Capable
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is capable of performing all of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Impact Shielding Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact reduces the damage caused to the shielded object by an impact with another object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Report
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nozzle Throat
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the narrowest portion of a Nozzle that is designed to converge the flow of fluid in order to increase the Velocity of the flow.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Predictive Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes an uncertain future event.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrastructure Element
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Infrastructure Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a bearer in virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Deception Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes which misinform or mislead some other entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Universal Time Reference System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Solar Time Reference System that is based on the average speed of the Earth's rotation and which uses the prime meridian at 0° longitude as a reference point.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Territory of a Country
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a The Domain of a Country.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Magnetism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition that is realized when its bearer exerts a magnetic force on another entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Weight
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in some material entity with a mass in virtue of its location in some gravitational field.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Steam Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An External Combustion Engine that is designed to use steam as its working fluid.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Refraction Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a refraction event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in direction of wave propagation due to a change in its transmission medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Appraisal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Measuring that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of something or someone.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Gaseous Propellant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gaseous state.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Heat Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to support the extraction of minerals or other geological materials from an orebody, lode, vein, seam, reef, or placer deposit within the earth.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Email Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Entertainment Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to host activities that are intended to hold the interest of, or give pleasure or delight to, an audience.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Realizable Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Realizable Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Low Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Oscillation Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Change in which the dependent entity alternates between two or more stases.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Permanent Resident
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A person with a Permanent Resident Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Highway
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Road that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to travel on routes that connect relatively major destinations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Organization Member
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Person who is affiliated with some Organization by being a member of that Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Color Brightness
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect or radiate light.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Non-Name Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified namespace or context, is not a Designative Name, may be automatically or randomly generated, and typically has no preexisting cultural or social significance.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ground Moving Target Indication Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Moving Target Indication Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to identify and track entities moving on or near the ground.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Containing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one entity contains another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decoy
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to distract or conceal what an individual or group might be looking for.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Algorithm
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Process and contains a finite sequence of unambiguous instructions in order to achieve some Objective.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Terrorism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Violence which creates fear and which is prescribed by religious, political or ideological objectives, and which deliberately target or disregard the safety of civilians and are committed by members of non-government organizations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mailing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for the systematic physical transportation of documents and packages.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiological Weapon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of releasing radioactive material.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Distance Measurement Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the spatial Distance to a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Missile Launcher
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Precision-Guided Missiles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Torque
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate of change of angular momentum of an object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Effect
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process that follows and is caused by some previous Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which public policy is administered and the actions of its members are directed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Territory of a Government Domain
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a Government Domain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Transmission Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer and regulate Power flow from a Power Source to an application point.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Relay Station
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communications Facility that is designed to support the receiving and re-transmitting of radio signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cleaning Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to remove foreign objects from another object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Neutral Person
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Neutral Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Combat Outpost
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the conduction of combat operations of limited scope or size.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Battery Terminal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect a load or charger to a single or multiple-cell Battery.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Distance Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a One-Dimensional Extent inhering in some Site that is externally connected to two Independent Continuants.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Distribution Port
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Port that is designed with the cargo handling equipment necessary for the loading and unloading of Watercraft.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Anti-Bacterial Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some bacterium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Super Low Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prosthetic Foot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing foot.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Calendar Year
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Year that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Year.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sound Wave Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mechanical Wave Process of Pressure and displacement that is parallel to the propogation direction of the Wave Process through a medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Inhabitancy
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which a Person lives at a Site for a period of time that may be as short as 1 day/night or as long as the Person's entire life.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Product Transport Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to transport some product.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Voltage Regulating Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to cause a change in the voltage magnitude between the sending and receiving end of an electrical component.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Attitude Control Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in an attitude control process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Medical Depot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store medical supplies.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: External Navigation Lighting System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to be attached to some Vehicle and to emit colored light in order to signal that Vehicle's position, heading, and status.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mirror
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to reflect light that has a wavelength within a given range and is incident on its relflecting surface such that the reflected light maintains most of the characteristics of the original light.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Diminutive Name
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Abbreviated Name that is a familiar form of a Proper Name.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Contract Formation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Promising having a lawful object entered into voluntarily by two or more agents with legal capacity, each of whom intends to create one or more legal obligations between them.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government Domain Border
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary of some Government Domain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Designative Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a set of symbols that designate some Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Training Acquisition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge from another Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Turbofan Air-Breathing Jet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbofan, which consists of a Turbine and a Fan.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Switch Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of breaking an electric circuit by interrupting the current or diverting it from one conductor to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed for use by some Agent in some Act of Communication where the recipient of that communication is potentially a significant distance away from the Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel Tank
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Fuel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Probability Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the likelihood that a Process or Process Aggregate occurs.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mass Specification
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of Mass that a Material Entity should have.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nozzle Mouth
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the portion of a Nozzle at the end that is designed to be where the flow of fluid exits the Nozzle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiolucent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to permit most X-rays to pass through it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ideology
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about how some part of the world is or should be and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents such that it forms the basis of their beliefs, goals, expectations, and motivations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Enemy Person
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Enemy Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Convergent-Divergent Nozzle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Nozzle that consists of a tube with an asymmetric hourglass shape that is designed to accelerate hot pressurized gas by converting the heat energy of the gas flow into kinetic energy as it passes through the Nozzle Throat to generate increased Exhaust Velocity of the gas as it exits the Nozzle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Afternoon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun is at its apex (approximately 12:00pm) and when it sets (approximately 6:00pm).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Computer Network
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Network that is designed to allow the exchange of data between two or more computers connected to the network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wire Receiver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Wire Antenna to intercept radio signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of an Image
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a System Clock
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument that is part of a computer and is designed to issue a steady high-frequency signal that is used to synchronize all of the computer's internal components.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Constructed Tunnel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Artifact that is designed to be substantially enclosed, have access constrained to portals, and to enable travel through surrounding soil, earth, or rock formation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Transmission Line
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Product Transport Facility that is designed to transmit electricity over distance via a system of above ground wires including their supports.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Terminal Board
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to join electrical terminations and create an electrical circuit by means of a block which connects individual wires without a splice or physically joining the ends.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Angle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the angle between two lines or planes in relation to a vertex.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Water Tower
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is the bearer of functions realized in processes of storing water in an elevated container.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Visual Prosthesis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, which performs the function of an eye.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Command Post Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the command and control of Military Operations or Forces.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Semi-automatic Pistol
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Hand Gun that has a single fixed firing chamber machined into the rear of the barrel and an ammunition magazine capable of holding multiple Cartridges such that the Hand Gun is designed to automatically reload each time it is fired and to fire a Bullet with each successive pull of the trigger until the stored ammunition is depleted.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Acceleration
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of the Velocity of an object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vehicle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate the movement of material entities from one location to another by conveying them there.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Horn Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flaring metal waveguide shaped like a horn to direct radio waves in a beam and can be used on its own or as a feeder for larger antenna structures, such as Parabolic Antennas.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prosthesis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Medical Artifact that is designed to replace a missing body part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to produce electric power by converting chemical energy to electrical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fossil Fuel Power Plant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert fossil fuels (e.g. coal, natural gas, or petroleum) into electrical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Village
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a hamlet but smaller than that of a Town.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Counterfeit Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cryogenic Storage Dewar
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Cryogenic Material (such as liquid helium or liquid oxygen) and which consists of, minimally, walls that are constructed from two or more layers that are separated by a high vacuum to provide thermal insulation between the interior and exterior of the dewar.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Polarizing Prism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prism designed to split a beam of light entering the Prism into components of varying polarization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sea Level
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fiat Surface that divides the spheroid composed of Earth and its atmosphere at some point that corresponds to the mean level of calm water in the Earth’s oceans.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vehicle Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Control System that is designed to enable some Agent to control some Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Parabolic Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Antenna that uses a parabolic reflector to direct or receive radio waves and has a very high gain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wedding
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which two Persons are united in Marriage or a similar institution.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one or more Information Content Entities are conveyed from one entity to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Submillimeter Wavelength Radio Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing radio waves from the submillimeter waveband (i.e. microwaves) to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spherical Coordinate System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Reference System for three-dimensional spatial regions that identifies each point using an ordered triple of numerical coordinates that consist of the radial distance of the point of interest from a fixed origin, its polar angle measured from a fixed zenith direction, and the azimuth angle of its orthogonal projection measured from a fixed direction on a reference plane that passes through the origin and is orthogonal to the zenith.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydraulic Power Transfer Unit
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer hydraulic power from one of an Aircraft's hydraulic systems to another in the event that a system has failed or been turned off.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity conforms to how it is expected or supposed to be.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Microwave Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 300 GHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spherical
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of all of its cross sections being round.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Explosive Land Mine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed under or on the ground.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Region Bounding Box Identifier List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate that is comprised of 4 pairs of coordinates, one for each of the 4 defining points (North, West, South, East) of a Geospatial Region Bounding Box.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Transducer
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Forward Operations Base
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Base that is located relatively close to an offensive Area of Operations, is supported by the Base of Operations, and is designed to support local strategic objectives and tactical operations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Length
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's greatest extent in one direction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Sojourn
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling temporarily, often during stages of an Act of Travel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Resource
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Continuant that is owned by, in the possession of, or is otherwise controlled by an Agent such that it could be used by that Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Targeting
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act wherein some Agent maintains one or more entities as the objects of potential action given some operational requirement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ignition System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to produce an Ignition process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Chart
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of an Image that is designed to carry some Representational Information Content Entity that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Social Group Membership
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Association wherein a Person belongs to some Social Group.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Point Estimate Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of a single value for the measured entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Combustion Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Heat Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy that is generated through a local Combustion process into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Canal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Water Transportation Artifact that is an artificial Hydrographic Feature designed to convey water or enable Watercraft to travel inland.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bullet
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be projected by a Firearm, Sling, Slingshot, or Air Gun, but which does not (typically) contain explosives.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Julian Day Number
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decimal Date Identifier that designates some Julian Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since the Julian Date epoch.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Text Messaging
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication occurs through the exchange of brief written messages between fixed-line phone or mobile phone and fixed or portable devices over a network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Action Permission
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Regulation that permits some Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wave Process Profile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile of a Wave Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ultra Low Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 Hz and 3 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Frequency that is characterized by the rate of Oscillations per second of an Electromagnetic Wave.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Zenith
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location upward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction opposite the apparent Gravitational Force at that location.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Database
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some set of specific Information Content Entities and to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Synagogue
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Judaic worship and prayer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Component Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity having a discrete structure in virtue of that entity being part of a system considered at a particular level of analysis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Color Saturation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect high intensity light distributed across fewer wavelengths, typically considered on a continuum of purity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Surface Wave Profile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the Wave Process propogates along the surface of a medium and which involves both transverse and longitudinal wave profiles such that the motion of the displacement of participating particles is circular or elliptical.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed to partially enclose a harbor and form a landing place for Watercraft.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fungicide Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some fungus or fungal spore.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Velocity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile of an object's Motion that is characterized by its Speed and direction with respect to a frame of reference.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Focusing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Processing Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a light focusing event in which the Material Artifact causes the light beam to converge on a target spatial point.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wave Production
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process in which a Wave Process is generated.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hardness
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which it can be turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Lubrication System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to contain, transfer, and regulate the flow of lubricant to multiple locations in a Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Amount
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the total, aggregate or sum of a number of discrete items or material the entity contains as parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Requesting
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by asking for something.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Density
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the mass of an object per unit of its total volume.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Imaging Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Imaging Artifact Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Impulsive Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is the integral of a Force that is applied to a portion of matter over a period of time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Curvilinear Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a curved path.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Video Camera
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and digitally or physically record a continuous stream of subsequent images of an entity or scene such that the images can be played back in succession as a video.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Locomotive
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that is designed to provide the motive power for a Train.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Signal Detection Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of discerning between information-bearing patterns and random patterns, or noise, that distract from the information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydraulic Motor
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts hydraulic pressure and flow into torque and angular displacement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Chemical Depot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store chemicals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Cryosphere
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A fiat object part of the frozen part of a natural satellite's hydosphere.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ethnicity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in its bearers by virtue of a common heritage, often consisting of a common language, a common culture (often including a shared religion) and an ideology that stresses common ancestry or endogamy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to manage, command, direct, or regulate the behavior of at least one other Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Factory
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for manufacturing or refining material products.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable Maintenance
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Non-Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Property
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that is realized when its bearer interacts with electromagnetic waves within the visible light spectrum.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Repeater
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Transceiver that is designed to receive a radio signal, amplify it, and retransmit it (often on another frequency).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Role that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Altitude
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Height that inheres in a Site that externally connects an Independent Continuant to either the surface of the Earth or the Earth's mean Sea Level.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Turbine Steam Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to extract thermal energy from pressurized steam and use it to do mechanical work on a rotating output shaft.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Translational Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Motion Process in which the participating Object changes its position from one portion of space to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Direct Current Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of direct current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Chemical Reaction Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process that leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Catadioptric Optical Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light through the use of a combination of Lenses and Mirrors to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel Ventilation System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to allow air into the Fuel Tank to take the place of burned fuel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Ellipse
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that is formed by following a symmetric arc between four vertices which are connected to the center point of the ellipse via a straight line.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electrical Conduction Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to conduct an electric current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rail Transport Vehicle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to convey cargo, passengers, or equipment by Railway.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hazel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is a combination of Brown and Green, typically associated with eye color.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Information Bearing Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that carries an Information Content Entity and is designed to do so using a particular format or structure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of one or more Information Bearing Artifacts that carry Information Content Entities and are the subjects of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Day
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the approximate length of time required for an Astronomical Body to complete one rotation around its Rotational Axis as specified relative to a particular Temporal Reference System.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: y-Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'y'.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stage
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Entertainment Facility that is designed to provide a space upon which entertaining performances or productions can occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Round
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of every point along its circumference being equidistant from the center.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to refract light and which consists of a transparent material with flat polished surfaces where at least two of these surfaces have an angle between them.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Coiled
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being wound in concentric rings or spirals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Tool
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Tool that is designed to be actuated by a Power Source and mechanism other than or in addition to manual labor.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Compression Ignition Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by igniting a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture using heat generated via compression of the mixture.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reactant Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which a substance or compound is added to a system in order to bring about a chemical reaction and is consumed in the course of the reaction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Submersible Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of operating while submerged in water.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Multi-Week Temporal Interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Weeks and spans at least one Week.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Wave Conversion Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to convert electric power into radio waves or radio waves into electric power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Pulse
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Wave Process that consists of a short high-energy burst of electromagnetic energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Nuclear Fuel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used in a nuclear fission process to produce energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Water Treatment Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for making water more acceptable for a specific end-use.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Folded
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of one part of the bearer being layered over another connected part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Liquid Nitrogen
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid nitrogen.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Line String
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that has two or more Geospatial Positions as vertices, where each vertex is connected to only one other vertex by a straight line.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Orange
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is between Red and Yellow with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 590 to 635 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process in which one or more Independent Continuants endure in an unchanging condition.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Function that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Promising
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by declaring that the promising agent will do, or refrain from doing, the specified action.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Very Low Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Communication Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of visible light.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Role that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Network Line
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact that is designed to be the physical transmission medium that connects two or more Telecommunication Network Nodes within a Telecommunication Network to facilitate communication between the Nodes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Refractivity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to change the direction of a propagating wave when passing through it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Time of Day Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Instant Identifier that designates some Time of Day.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pesticide Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Poison Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing that is detrimental to humans or human concerns.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Time Zone Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Region Identifier that designates the region associated with some uniform standard time for legal, commercial, or social purposes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Speed
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the magnitude of an object's motion with respect to a frame of reference during some time period.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Herbicide Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death to, unwanted plants.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Year
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the approximate length of time required for an Astronomical Body to complete one Orbital Revolution around its Primary Body as specified relative to a particular Temporal Reference System.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Julian Date Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates a Julian Date and is composed of both a Julian Day Number and a Julian Date Fraction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mid Infrared Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 20 and 214 terahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Body Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a Person's body by virtue of the body's general outline or figure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Financial Instrument Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Financial Instrument.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Family
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Persons related to one another by ancestry or marriage.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Fuel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to release thermal energy when reacted with other substances.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Donating
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is tranfered by an Agent (the Donor) to another Agent (the Recipient) without return consideration.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bicycle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Vehicle that consists of two wheels, one in front of the other, attached to a frame along with handlebars and pedals such that it is designed to receive its motive power from pedaling.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Explosive Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of the rapid increase in volume and release of energy in an extreme manner.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sub-Bass Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 20 and 60 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Solar Panel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more photovoltaic (i.e. solar) cells that convert light energy (photons) directly into electricity by means of the photovoltaic effect.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Temperature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the thermal energy in an object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Proportional Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a portion of a whole (described by the numerator) compared against that whole (described by the denominator) where the whole is a nominally described set of like entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydroelectric Power Plant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert hydropower into electrical power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Active Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is realizing one or more of its designed Artifact Functions (especially one of its primary functions).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mounted Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Firearm that is designed to be fired while mounted.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Heating System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to heat the air or objects in a Site.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears some Quality that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Light Machine Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Long Gun that is designed to fire bullets in quick succession from an ammunition belt or magazine and to be employed by an individual soldier, with or without assistance, and typically weighing 9-22 lbs.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Work
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of displacements of points to which Forces have been applied.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Descriptive Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that describes some Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Realizable Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Effect of Location Change
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Effect caused by some Act of Location Change and which results in an Object being located in a different place.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact History
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A History of a Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ultra High Frequency Communication Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some Ultra High Frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Improvised Explosive Device
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be used in non-conventional military action.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Television Broadcast
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs via transmissions through a television network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Allied Person
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Ally Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Split
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening, or having been divided into parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sound Process Profile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is part of a sound reception process and is characterized by properties of incoming sound waves as they are translated by some sensory system.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Confessing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Representative Communication in which a person makes an admission of misdeeds or faults.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Public Safety Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of preventing and responding to events that could endanger the safety of the general public from significant danger, injury/harm, or damage, such as crimes or disasters (natural or man-made).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Broadcast
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience is mediated through radio waves transmitted through a radio network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pipeline
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Product Transport Facility that is designed to transport goods or materials through a pipe.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rocket Pod
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to contain several Unguided Rockets held in individual tubes and to be used by Aircraft or Helicopters for close air support.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Camera
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from visible light.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrastructure System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that is composed of elements bearing Infrastructure Roles and is by itself sufficient to provide a planned service or benefit to some organization that maintains its elements.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Plant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, autotrophic, and has cells that contain chloroplasts and walls made of cellulose.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Brown
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that consists of dark orange and red, and of very low intensity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Physiographic Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geographic Feature that is a geomorphological unit characterized by its surface form and location in the landscape.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Video
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in the form of a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Personal Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication that the sender intends to be received by a small audience.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Brake Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the process of braking with the aim of preventing rolling, skidding, and hydroplaning.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Identification Friend or Foe Transponder
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Transponder that is designed to automatically transmit a predefined signal in response to receiving an appropriate interrogation signal such that the entity it is located on can be positively identified as friendly.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Religious Group Affiliation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Association wherein some Person belongs to some Religious Demonination or sub-Denomination.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Religious Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes related to worship and prayer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Storage Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to store materials or goods.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wind Farm
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert the wind's kinetic energy into electrical power by means of wind turbines.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Inviting
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by requesting the presence or participation of the audience, and which may include offering an incentive or inducement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Loaning
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is given by an Agent (the Creditor) to another Agent (the Debtor) in order to receive Repayments from the Debtor which are of greater Financial Value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wavy
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having a sinuous or rippled border.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wired Communication Reception Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Reception Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact receives information transmitted from another Material Artifact, where the transmission of information occurs via a direct connection using an electrical conductor.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: City
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a relatively large human population permanently resides; is designated as a city based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically oversees the provision of systems for sanitation, utilities, land usage, housing, and transportation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: High Frequency Communication Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some High Frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Visible Observation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Observation that involves visual perception.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Travel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein one or more Persons move between relatively distant geographical locations for any purpose and any duration, with or without any means of transport.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Calendar System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is designed to organize and identify dates.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Depth
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a downward, backward, or inward direction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Information Medium Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to have some Information Bearing Artifact as part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decimal Date Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since a specified Reference Time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Married
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant that consists of a socially, culturally, or ritually recognized union or legal contract between spouses that establishes rights and obligations between them, between them and their children, and between them and their in-laws.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mean Point Estimate Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the sum of all the values in the set divided by the total number of values in the set.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Oxidizer
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Material that is disposed to steal electrons from other substances (i.e. to oxidize other substances) as a participant in a reduction-oxidation process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geopolitical Power Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role had by an Organization, that is perceived by an International Community as capable of performing influential acts in that community, and which would be realized in performing such acts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Communication Relay Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information without the use of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decontamination Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Washing Facility that is designed to wash personnel or equipment after (potential) contamination by radioactive, biological, or chemical material.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Facility Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which an Agent makes use of some Facility.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Communication Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed to enable communication between two or more entities via the use of radio waves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vehicle Track
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Object Track for a Vehicle during some motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Post Office
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mailing Facility that is designed for serving customers of the national postal system.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Email Box
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to be the delivery destination of Email Messages that are addressed to the corresponding Email Address.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telephone
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to provide point-to-point communication between agents by means of audio messages.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Material Artifact Processing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act of performing a series of physical operations on a material artifact in order to change or preserve the artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Emergency AC/DC Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to provide electrical power in an emergency situation by means of both alternating current and direct current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Amplitude
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile of an Oscillation Process that is the absolute value of the maximum displacement from a zero, equilibrium, or mean value during one cycle of the Oscillation Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Semi-Major Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that is equal to half the length of the Major Axis of an Ellipse.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pyramidal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a polygonal base with vertices that all connect to the same apex to form triangular faces.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Maroon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color consisting of purple and brown hue.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Group of Persons
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Persons as member parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Acronym
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Abbreviated Name that combines the initial letters of a Designative Name and which is pronounced as a word.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Lunar Calendar System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of the Moon's phases.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Permanent Resident Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A role inhering in a Person by virtue of that Person being recognized as having legal resident status in a Government Domain in which that person is not a citizen but where they have the right to reside on a permanent basis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Network Node
