https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact that consists of a connection point, redistribution point, or endpoint that is designed to be part of a Telecommunication Network and can be either active or passive.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Parts List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of some type of Material Artifact that are part of or located on another Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Death
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process in which all biological functions that sustain a living organism cease.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Calendar Day
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Day that begins and ends concurrently with the Seconds specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Seconds of the Day.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Arrival
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the larger Act of Location Change is completed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Arbitrary Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Non-Name Identifier that consists of a string of characters that does not follow an encoding system.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Beginning of Life Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Operational Stasis that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is first put into operational use such that its designed set of Artifact Functions is capable of operating at or near their designed peak performance levels.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Military Training Acquisition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Military Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Apologizing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by acknowledging and expressing regret for a fault, shortcoming, or failure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bass Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 60 and 250 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Train Car
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single Vehicle that is not a Train but is designed to be connected to other Train Cars along with at least one Locomotive to form a Train.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Part Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being part of some other entity without being subject to further subdivision or disassembly without destruction of its designated use.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nickel-metal Hydride Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a metal-hydride anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Computing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a computation process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Landline Telephone
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network through a pair of wires.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Constituent State
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the State.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Legal Instrument Use
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Legal Instrument.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Deactivated Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is not realizing any of its designed Artifact Functions (or at least not realizing any of its primary functions).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to inhibit the motion of some object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Financial Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of managing money.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Line
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has only two vertices.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Momentum
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the Momentum of a portion of matter that is in Motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Phosphorescence
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light after absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, and to continue emitting after the absorbing process has ceased.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sniper Rifle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rifle that is designed to be highly accurate for long-range precision tactical shooting.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ocular Prosthesis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, but which does not function as an eye.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thermal Imaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to create a visual representation of an entity using radiation from the far infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum that the entity emits

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: X-ray Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing X-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government Building
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for the administration of a community.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Temperature Measurement Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Temperature of a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Religious Worship
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Ceremony wherein there occurs acts of religious devotion usually directed towards a deity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Consumption
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which a resource is ingested or used up.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Maintenance
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Modification in which a Material Artifact is modified in order to preserve or restore one or more of its designed Qualities or Functions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Wave Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process that is produced by charged particles, involves the periodic Oscillation of electric and magnetic fields at right angles to each other and the direction of wave propogation such that it has a Transverse Wave Profile, and which transfers electromagnetic radiant energy through a portion of space or matter.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electric Motor
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pitch
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the frequency of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from low to high.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Infrastructure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Infrastructure System that is designed to support the use of Telecommunication Instruments to communicate.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Angular Momentum
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Momentum that is the product of an object's moment of inertia and its Angular Velocity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Highway Interchange
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Road Junction that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one or more Highways and enter another Highway without directly crossing any other traffic stream.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reservoir
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store water in a man-made open enclosure or area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the number of times an event repeats per unit of time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fixed Line Network Telephone Call
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a telephone network where the telephones are wired into a single telephone exchange.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Current Conversion Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert some electrical current.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Liquid Propellant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a liquid state.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel Transfer System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to facilitate the transfer of some Portion of Fuel from the Fuel Tank for use in some Engine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Medium Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 kHz and 3 MHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Height
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a vertical direction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Assault Rifle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rifle that is designed to have selective-fire functionality and use an intermediate Cartridge and a detachable magazine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Speed
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rates at which objects traverse distance.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Artifact Modification
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing in which an existing Material Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Deceptive Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decimal Time of Day Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using a decimal value for the portion of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Plan
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cyan
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is between Green and Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 490 and 520 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Political Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Documentary
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Publishing a factual record or report.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cause
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process that is the cause of or one of the causes of some other Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Closure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which that bearer affords passage or sightline through it via an opening, aperture, orifice, or vent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Waste Material
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that serves no further use in terms of the initial user's own purposes of production, transformation, or consumption such that the Agent wants to dispose of it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Portion of Material Consumption
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which a Portion of Material is expended.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Function that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Shear Wave Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mechanical Wave that has a Transverse Wave Profile.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Occupation Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thermal Insulation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Thermal Control Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact prevents or reduces the transfer of heat between objects that are in thermal contact or in range of radiative influence.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Scar
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and which was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Citizen Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reflective Prism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prism designed to reflect light in order to flip, invert, rotate, deviate, or displace a beam of light entering the Prism.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Super High Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 3 and 30 GHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nickname
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Name that is a familiar or humorous substitute for an entity's Proper Name.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more angles along its border.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Second
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the duration of 9,192,631,770 periods of the radiation corresponding to the transition between the two hyperfine levels of the ground state of the cesium 133 atom.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Power Rectifying Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electrical Power Production Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to generate electrical power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that was designed by some Agent to realize a certain Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ramjet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air (without the use of an axial compressor) and decelerate it to subsonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Disrupting Disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process some entity has an interest in.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Network
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable the transmission of information over significant distances between Telecommunication Endpoints via Telecommunication Network Nodes and Lines.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Defunct Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact no longer maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least no longer maintains its primary functions).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spray Nozzle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Nozzle that is designed to facilitate a conversion of the flow of a portion of liquid into a dynamic collection of drops dispersed in a portion of gas.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Drooping
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a border that hangs downwards.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is relatively brief and to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cartridge
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to package a Bullet, a propellant substance, and a primer within a case that is designed to fit within the firing chamber of a Firearm.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Electromagnetic Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the electromagnetic force between electrically charged entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Turbojet Air-Breathing Jet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbojet, which consists of a Turbine with a Propelling Nozzle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Operator Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Passenger Train Car
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport passengers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Biological Weapon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, incapacity, or death by means of releasing disease-producing agents—such as bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Telescope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places an Entity into some rank order.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Automobile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a small number of passengers while traveling on four tired wheels.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Heating Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system increases.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Proper Name
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Name that is an official name for a particular entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Controlled-Access Highway
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Highway that is designed for high-speed vehicular traffic, with traffic flow and ingress/egress regulated.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Lithosphere
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A fiat object part of the rigid, outermost rocky shell of a natural satellite.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Agent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Equipment Cooling System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to cool some piece of equipment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Steering Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the direction some Vehicle is traveling.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Gaseous Fuel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a gaseous state.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Denying
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by either asserting that something is not true or real or refusing to satisfy a request or desire.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places a Quality of an Entity onto an interval scale having a true zero value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Calendar Week
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Week that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Week.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spark Ignition Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by generating a spark to ignite a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electric Generator
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to convert mechanical energy to electrical energy for use in an external circuit.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pointing Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Orientation of a Material Entity in which one or more of its designated components are oriented toward a specified direction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Trim Tab
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Control Surface that is designed to counteract hydro-, aerodynamic, or other forces in order to stabilize the Vehicle it is part of in the desired Attitude.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Mechanical Wave Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process that involves Oscillation of a portion of matter such that energy is transferred through the material medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Unguided Rocket
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled, but unguided, projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances through the use of a Rocket Engine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Train
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a series of connected Train Cars or Railcars.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Volunteering
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by voluntarily undertaking or expressing a willingness to undertake a service.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Assignment
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which rights held by one party (the assignor) are transferred to another party (the assignee) with regard to a particular entity as specified by the details of the assignment, which is often prescribed by a contract.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Biological Sex
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Full Motion Video Camera
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Video Camera that is designed to capture and record images of sufficiently high quality and in rapid enough succession that the resulting video supports smooth playback.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pitch Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass and is perpendicular both to the direction of the object's motion and to the object's Yaw Axis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable some Act of Communication by means of transmission systems, relay stations, tributary stations, and data terminal equipment, usually capable of interconnection and interoperation to form an integrated whole.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Constructed Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature that has been constructed by deliberate human effort.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nickel Cadmium Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a cadmium anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Repayment
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Debtor) to another Agent (the Creditor) to decrease the amount the Debtor owes to the Creditor from an earlier Act of Loaning.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nadir
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location downward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction of the apparent Gravitational Force at that location.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sequence Position Ordinality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the position of some entity in some ordered sequence.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Equipment Mount
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to support a Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Aircraft
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by air travel.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nuclear Radiation Detection Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to detect the presence of nuclear radiation particles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Model
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a common set of Functions and Qualities to inhere in a set of artifact instances.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Notification Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the number of repetitive processes during a particular time period.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has an increase in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electrical Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, and transfer power in the form of electrical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Primary Cell Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Electric Battery that is designed for one-time use and not to be recharged.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Projectile Launcher
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict damage or harm by means of launching a high-velocity projectile at a target.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Military Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to support a Military Force.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Collision
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Location Change involving the movement of one object such that it collides with another object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Helical Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a conducting wire wound in the form of a helix that is typically mounted over a ground plane with a feed line connected between the bottom of the helix and the ground plane.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Branched
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having subdivisions or offshoots.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Visible Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 400 and 800 terahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Press Release
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Issuing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hour
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to sixty consecutive Minutes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Shape Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the ratios between dimensions of external features of that bearer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to pump, manage, and deliver some Portion of Fuel to the Propulsion System and Auxiliary Power Unit of some Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motorcycle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a very small number of passengers (usually 1 or 2) while traveling on two or three tired wheels.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: International Community
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations engaged in geopolitics with one another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Straight
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Barcode
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry one or more geometric shapes that concretize some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Two Dimensional Extent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Disposition.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Laser
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light coherently through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Quality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Representational Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Content Entity that represents some Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fluid Control Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the direction or flow of some fluid.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Payload Capacity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in a Vehicle that is designed to transport Payload, and which is typically characterized by the maximum Weight, Mass, or Volume of Payload that the Vehicle can transport.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: FM Radio Broadcast Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Very High Frequency that is between 88 and 108 MHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Financial Value of Property
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: Financial Value that inheres in an material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Educational Training Acquisition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of a curriculum from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with some Educational Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Training Instruction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by imparting knowledge to another Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electric Power Station
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to generate electrical power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Heavy Machine Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire ammunition greater than .50 caliber or 12.7mm ammunition in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs more than 30lbs.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Airport
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed for launching, receiving, and housing Aircraft.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Blond
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that ranges from nearly white to a light greyish yellow.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Far Infrared Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 300 gigahertz and 20 terahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geographic Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Environmental Feature that is a natural (i.e. not human made) topographical feature having a (relatively) stable location in some Geospatial Region which can be designated by location-specific data.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Patch Receiver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Patch Antenna to intercept radio signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Air-Breathing Combustion Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Reaction Engine that functions by drawing a continuous stream of air into and through the Engine where it is compressed, mixed with a Portion of Fuel, ignited, and then expelled as exhaust gas.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Processed Material
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is the output of an Act of Material Artifact Processing.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reflection Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a reflection event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in a wavefront at an interface between the reflecting medium and the transmission medium such that the wavefront returns into the transmission medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Road Junction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one Road and enter another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Orientation Observation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Orientation of a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decade
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to a period of ten consecutive Years.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Petrochemical Refinery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining crude oil, intermediate petroleum products, or synthetic petroleum into products of value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Pressure
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of Force applied perpendicular to a surface per unit area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fort
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the defense of or solidification of rule over some Geospatial Region and its inhabitants.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electrical Power Storage Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to store electrical power to be released at a later time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Coin
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a flat, portable, round pieces of metal designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Espionage
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering involving the obtaining of information that is considered secret or confidential without the permission of the holder of the information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cellular Telecommunication Network
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wireless Telecommunication Network where the last link between the network and the end user is wireless and is distributed over service areas called cells.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Submachine Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Long Gun that is designed to be have automatic-fire functionality, fire pistol-caliber ammunition that is magazine-fed, and which is usually smaller than other automatic firearms.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Common Stock
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to voting on corporate decisions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hospital
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Healthcare Facility that is designed to provide patient treatment with specialized staff and equipment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bridge
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to span physical obstacles without closing the way underneath to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to pass over the obstacles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure one or more features of a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of an interval of possible (or probable) values for the measured entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Commercial Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for buying and selling goods and services, especially on a large scale.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artifact Model Name
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Material Artifact Model.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Long Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a longer barrel than a Hand Gun and to be fired while braced against the shoulder.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Secondary Cell Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electric Battery that is designed to be recharged.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Roll Axis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the front to the back of the object as defined by the direction of the object's motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Landfill
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for disposing of waste by burial.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ultra High Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 3 GHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Counter-Clockwise Rotational Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the left as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Evening
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun sets (approximately 6:00pm) and when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Low Midrange Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 250 and 500 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Proper Acceleration
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Acceleration of an object relative to a free-fall, or inertial, observer who is momentarily at rest relative to the object being measured (hence, gravity does not cause Proper Acceleration).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Magenta
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color consisting of red and blue hues.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Division of Delimiting Domain
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and not a Delimiting Domain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Private Network Telephone Call
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where a closed group of telephones are connected primarily to each other and use a gateway to reach the outside world.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reference Time
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Instant specified as the origin for which other Temporal Regions are measured or identified.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Propelling Nozzle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Nozzle that is used to convert a propulsion Engine into a Jet Engine and functions by using its narrowest part, the throat, to increase Pressure within the Engine by constricting flow, usually until the flow chokes, then expanding the exhaust stream to, or near to, atmospheric pressure, while forming it into a high speed jet to propel the Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Surface Tension
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Form Document
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that has one or more Material Copy of a Document Field as parts in which to write or select prescribed content.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Religious Training Instruction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Religious Organization by imparting knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Scramjet Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air at supersonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Interference
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process in which a radio signal is disrupted, whether unintentionally or as the result of an Act of Radio Jamming, Act of Radio Spoofing, or similar Planned Act.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Poison Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Precision-Guided Missile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled and precision-guided projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Set of Eyes
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Luminescent Property
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light, but which isn't the result of the bearer being heated.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Quality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Residing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling permanently or for an extended period of time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pressurization Control Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ventilation Control Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the partial pressure of air in some space.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Polygon
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has at least three vertices where the connecting lines form a closed loop.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Mission Capability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a temporal interval when a Continuant's capability (or lack thereof) to perform its intended Functions, tasks, or Objectives remains at a relatively constant level.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Natural Process in which a Continuant changes its Location or Spatial Orientation over some Temporal Interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vehicle Frame
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be the main supporting structure of some Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Liquid Fuel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a liquid state.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Ultrasonic Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Frequency that is greater than 20 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiation Reflectivity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to scatter or reflect electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Beverage Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a horizontal wire one-half to two wavelengths long that is suspended above the ground with one end attached to the receiver feedline and the other grounded and which is typically used in the low and medium frequency radio bands.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spacecraft
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by Spaceflight.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Flywheel
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to store rotational energy such that it has a significant moment of inertia which enables it to resist changes in rotational speed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrastructure Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in the bearer of a Disposition and has been assigned to an Infrastructure System such that the realization of that Disposition is sometimes part of the functioning of the Infrastructure System.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Violet
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Facsimile Transmission
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which a Document Content Entity is transmitted over a Telephone Network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Entertainment
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act consisting of any activity which provides a diversion or permits people to amuse themselves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Receiver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to extract information from radio waves intercepted by a Radio Antenna by using electronic filters to separate the desired radio frequency signal from other signals, an electronic amplifier to increase the power of the signal, and demodulation to recover the desired information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sidereal Time Reference System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on Earth's rate of rotation measured relative to one or more fixed Stars (rather than the Sun).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Violence
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of electromagnetic radiation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Data Range Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the absolute difference between the largest value and the smallest value in the set.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Ammunition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by being projected toward its target at a significant Velocity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Paper
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of pressing together moist fibres of cellulose pulp derived from wood, rags, or grasses, and drying them into flexible sheets.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government Domain
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Damaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Multi-Second Temporal Interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Seconds and spans at least one Second.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Full Motion Video Imaging Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce video of entities that is of high enough quality to make the represented motion appear continuous to human viewers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Information Line
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of a single line or row of some larger Information Bearing Artifact of which it is a part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydraulic Power Source
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of pressurized liquid.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Data Transformation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Information Processing in which an algorithm is executed to act upon one or more input Information Content Entities into one or more output Information Content Entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bond
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to secure an Agent's debt for the holders of that debt.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Solvent Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in the dissolving of other substances (namely, solutes) without change in the former's chemical structure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Counterfeit Legal Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Legal Instrument.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Commissive Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent commits themselves to doing, or refraining from doing, some future action.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes the extent, dimensions, quantity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: County
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order or Second-Order Administrative Region.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Terrorist Training Camp
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Training Camp designed to teach students methods of terrorism.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Multi-Minute Temporal Interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Minutes and spans at least one Minute.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Midrange Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 500 Hz and 2 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reaction Mass
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Entity against which a Propulsion System operates in order to produce Acceleration.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication Relay Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in processes of first receiving and then transmitting information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hard X-ray Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 3 and 30 exahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wireless Network Telephone Call
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where the telephones are not dependent on a physical connection to the network such that they can continue to operate anywhere within the coverage area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Gelatinous Propellant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gelatinous state.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rocket Launcher
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Unguided Rockets.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Shielding Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an electromagnetic field is blocked by barriers made of conductive or magnetic materials.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Language
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a canonical format for communication.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Estimate Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of an entity based on partial information about that entity or an appropriately similar entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Roll Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Roll Axis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Railway Crossing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to cross a Railway when traveling along a road or path that is perpendicular to and at the same elevation as the Railway at the point where they overlap.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Digital Storage Device
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of recording that information in digital (binary) format.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Triple Inertial Navigation System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Inertial Navigation System that is designed to use three redundant computers to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references, in such a way that eliminates the need for a navigator.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Phase Angle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle between the light incident onto an observed Object and the light reflected from the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Social Network
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spinning Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that passes through the Object's Center of Mass.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rocket
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to travel through air or space and which obtains Thrust from a Rocket Engine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Color Hue
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect a dominant wavelength of the visible light spectrum, which is typically divided up into 6 to 8 ranges.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Navigation System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable an Agent or Material Artifact to determine the position or direction of some object, usually for the purpose of monitoring or controlling the movement of some Vehicle from one place to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Denture
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace missing teeth.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Blue
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is between Cyan and Violet with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 450 to 490 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telephone Call
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which sound is used to communicate over a telephone network to one or more recipients.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Operational Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least maintains its primary functions).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Bidirectional Transducer that is designed to convert electric power into radio waves, and radio waves into electric power.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fatigability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer loses strength and tires quickly.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gain of Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes bearer of some Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Geospatial Error Region
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that bounds some Geospatial Region according to probability estimations for locating some object within it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Artifact Assembly
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein a new Material Artifact are created by fitting component parts together.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Anthropogenic Feature
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Environmental Feature that is related to or is the result of the influence of human beings on the environment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Railcar
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single self-propelled Vehicle that is not a Train, is designed to transport passengers, and which may also be designed to connect to other Railcars to form a Train.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Protruding
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a part of an object in virtue of the part extending out above or beyond the surface of the object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Structural Support Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact providing physical support to another object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Trail
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable transport through rough country, such as a forest or moor.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Size Quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Delimiting Domain
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Night
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm) and when the sun dawns (approximately 6:00am).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Priority Scale
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Reference System that is designed to be used to rank or identify the importance of entities of the specified type.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Multi-Year Temporal Interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Years and spans at least one Year.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Optical Lens
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to focus or disperse a beam of light entering the lens by means of refraction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: High Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 MHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Retail Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of selling goods or merchandise in small or individual lots for direct consumption by persons or organizations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Lifting Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to lift some object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Female Sex
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual that only produces gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stasis of Artifact Operationality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact's designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least its primary functions) or the realizations of those functions remain unchanged.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Funeral
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which the Life of a Person who has died is celebrated, sanctified, or remembered.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Periscope
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to enable observation of an object that is located over, around, or through another object, obstacle, or condition that prevents direct line-of-sight observation from the observer's current position.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Medium Machine Gun
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire full-power rifle Cartridges (less than .50 caliber or 12.7mm) in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs 22-30 lbs.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Signal Processing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of transferring or processing information contained in signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Delta-v
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Profile that is the total change in Velocity of an object's Motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Opaque
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's incapacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Physically Powered Engine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert potential or kinetic energy into mechanical energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Solar Panel System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more Solar Panels, a power inverter, electrical wiring between the components, a mounting and support structure, and may also include a battery and/or a solar tracking system and is the bearer of functions realized in processes of deriving, transferring, and storing electrical energy derived from light energy.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Dish Receiver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Parabolic (or Dish) Antenna to intercept radio signals.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Process Requirement
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Yellow
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Employment by an Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Employment wherein an Organization assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Longitudinal Wave Profile
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is parallel to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation such that the particles alternate between participating in processes of compression and rarefaction as they participate in individual Wave Processes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Journal Article
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry a specific brief composition on a specific topic as part of a Journal Issue.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Alkaline Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Primary Cell Electric Battery that has a Zinc anode and Manganese (IV) oxide cathode.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rhombic Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of one to three parallel wires suspended above the ground by poles or towers at each vertex in a rhombic shape with each of the four sides being the same length (typically at least one wavelength or longer).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Brilliance Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 6 and 20 kHz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Possession
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which an agent intentionally exercises control towards a thing.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Crushing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of significant pressure.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Neutralization Artifact Function
