https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an acid and a base react quantitatively with each other.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Military Time Zone Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Zulu time, which has no offset from Coordinated Universal Time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Suicide
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Violence in which some Agent intentionally and voluntarily causes their own death.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Birth
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process of bringing forth offspring.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Initialism
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Abbreviated Name that consists of the initial letters of some words (or syllables) in a Designative Name, and in which each letter is pronounced separately.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Group of Organizations
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Communication Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of radio waves.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sensor Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Function that is realized in processes wherein an attribute of its bearer is a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Actuator
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transducer that is designed to convert some control signal into mechanical motion.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Document Field
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Entity that is a part of some document into which carriers of prescribed information can be written or selected.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Article
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Issuing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Under Active Control
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Active Stasis during which a Material Artifact participates in an Act of Artifact Employment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telecommunication Endpoint
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that connects a Telecommunication Terminal to a Telecommunication Network.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Artificial Eye
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing eye.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cabin Pressurization Control System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to control the process in which conditioned air is pumped into the Cabin of some Aircraft or Spacecraft in order to create a safe and comfortable environment for passengers and crew flying at high altitudes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Interior Lighting System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to emit light within the interior of some area.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Intelligence Gathering
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act of producing and/or gathering information by a government or other Organization to guide decisions and actions by answering questions or obtaining advance warning of events and movements deemed to be important or otherwise relevant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Propulsion Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function creates force leading to an entity's movement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fuel Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Portion of Fuel is reacted with other substances in order to release chemical or nuclear energy to be used for heat or for work.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Revolver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Hand Gun having a number of firing chambers in a revolving cylinder, where each chamber in the cylinder can be loaded with a single Cartridge.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Insecticide Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes harm to, or the death of, an insect.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Reliability Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity can consistently produce an outcome.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nuclear Storage Depot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store nuclear material.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Port
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed to contain harbors for docking Watercraft and for transfering people or cargo to and from land.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Atmosphere
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A fiat object part of the layer of gas or layers of gases that envelop a natural satellite.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Identifying
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by asserting who or what a particular person or thing is.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Person
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Documentary
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Issuing information that provides a factual record or report.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Public Address System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication System that is designed to allow a Person to speak to a large audience.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Vocational Training Instruction
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider by imparting skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Propaganda
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Deceptive Communication Propaganda intended to influence the attitude of a mass audience toward some cause or position by presenting facts selectively (thus possibly lying by omission) or by using loaded messages to produce an emotional rather than rational response to the information presented.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Warning
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by indicating a possible or impending danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Howitzer
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Cannon that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to use relatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles in relatively high trajectories with a steep angle of descent.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wired Communication Relay Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information by means of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Murder
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Homicide with malice aforethought.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrasonic Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Frequency that is below 20 Hz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Nominal Speed Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains a speed that does not exceed some specified tolerance of that Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Carrier Air Wing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Red
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that is above Orange with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 635 to 700 nanometers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Stock
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Financial Instrument that entitles holders to an ownership interest (equity) in the specified Incorporated Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vibration Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Motion wherein some participant repetitively deviates from a central location to two surrounding locations.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Flat
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border without a significant deviation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Emulsifier Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which two or more liquids that are normally immiscible are mixed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hydraulic Valve
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of a liquid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Refinery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Factory that is designed for refining raw materials into products of value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Crew
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Revolving Motion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that is located externally to the Site occupied by the Object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Waveform
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the shape of the Wave Cycles of the Wave Process when depicted in a visual graph.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Maintenance Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to be used to perform actions to maintain or improve the state of some property or equipment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Round Shot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a solid projectile without explosive charge and to be fired from a cannon.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Damaged Stasis
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of lesser value, usefulness, or functionality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Length
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of one-dimensional regions or Geospatial Regions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radiation Absorptivity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to absorb electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bus
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a large number of people and to travel on six or more tired wheels.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Perimeter
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the extent of a boundary which encloses the bearer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Three Dimensional Extent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Financial Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to support the management of money.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Pitch Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Pitch Axis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Military Headquarters Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Military Facility that is designed for military administration and coordination.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Material Copy of a Document
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams in the form of physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Wetting Agent Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that reduces the water repellent tendency of a substance thereby allowing it to become wet.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Patch Antenna
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flat rectangular sheet (or patch) of metal mounted over a larger sheet of metal called a ground plane which is typically contained inside a plastic radome for protection and is small enough that it can be mounted on a flat surface.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Service Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of providing intangible goods to consumers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Civil Organization
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization that is not commercial or military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Position Observation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the position of a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Dimension Specification
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Quality Specification that prescribes some Size Quality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Loss of Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Loss of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Observation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Mass Flow Rate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit of Flow that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which the Mass of a substance passes per unit time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sewage Treatment Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for removing contaminants from wastewater, especially sewage.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Lot Number
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Covering Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity is covered.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Aircraft Manufacturing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture Aircraft.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Paramilitary Force
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and (often) function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Article of Clothing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to cover some portion of a body.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Legal System Act
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act performed by an Agent that realizes their role within the context of a legal system of some jurisdiction.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Waste Management Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed for managing waste for some portion of the waste's existence.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gimbal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Equipment Mount that consists of a pivoted support that allows a Material Artifact to Rotate about one or more Axes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Volume
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of sites or three-dimensional spatial regions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Yaw Orientation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Tank
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry heavy firepower, have a powerful Engine, and travel on one or more continuous tracks such that it is suitable for front-line combat and can provide operational maneuverability as well as tactical offensive and defensive capabilities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Radio Transceiver
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device composed of both a Radio Transmitter and a Radio Receiver that share common circuitry or a single housing.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Lead Acid Electric Battery
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a lead anode and lead oxide cathode.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Decrease of Generically Dependent Continuant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of a Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bearing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which the Material Artifact constrains relative motion to only the desired motion, and reduces friction between moving parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Process Regulation
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Renting
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Renter) as a payment to acquire temporary possession or use of a good or property that is owned or controlled by another Agent (the Seller).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Land Transportation Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via land

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Social Act
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act having an objective that affects, is performed by, or is performed on behalf of, a community or group of Persons.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Temporal Reference System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for measuring time as well as understanding the context of and organizing temporal data.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Education Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of transmiting accumulated knowledge skills and values from one generation to another.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Telemetry Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Mechanical Process that is highly automated and in which measurements are made or other data is collected and transmitted to receiving equipment to facilitate the monitoring of environmental conditions or equipment parameters at a remote or inaccessible location.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Legal Name
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Proper Name that is an official name for the designated entity as determined by a Government or court of law.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 3 and 30 petahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rosy
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Purchasing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Purchaser) to acquire a good or service from another Agent (the Provider).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Government
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Domain.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Ownership
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Possession that includes an agent having certain rights and duties over the property owned.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infrared Light Frequency
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 gigahertz and 430 tetrahertz.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Timbre
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the variation, spectrum, or envelope of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from dull or dark to bright.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Walking
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Travel that proceeds by foot.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Calendar Date Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a combination of Day, Week, Month, or Year Identifiers formatted according to an implementation of a Calendar System.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Portion of Geosphere
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A fiat object part that is composed of one or more portions of the atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, or lithosphere.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry infantry into battle and to provide fire support for them.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Circuit Breaker
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to protect an electrical circuit from damage caused by excess current from an overload or short circuit.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Biological Depot
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store biological agents.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Impulse
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the integral of a Force applied to a portion of matter over a temporal interval.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Legal Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a formally executed written document that can be formally attributed to its author, records and formally expresses a legally enforceable act, process, or contractual duty, obligation, or right, and therefore evidences that act, process, or agreement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Behavior
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act in which an Independent Continuant participates as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Three-Dimensional Position
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Three-Dimensional Spatial Region that encompasses the (minimal) spatial region in which some object is located at a particular time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Grey
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color between white and black colors.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Thermal Control Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact increasing, decreasing, or maintaining the temperature of itself, a part of itself, or another object.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Cartesian Coordinate System
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n-dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are the signed (i.e. positive or negative) distances measured in the same unit of length from the zero point where the fixed perpendicular Coordinate System Axes meet.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Greenwich Mean Time Zone Identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Greenwich Mean Time.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Speed Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which its bearer has some speed.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Vermilion
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Freight Train Car
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport cargo.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Increase of Disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Measurement Unit of Time
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of temporal regions.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: School
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Education Facility that is designed to provide learning space and environments for teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Manufacturing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Three Dimensional Shape
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Healing Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which health is restored to an unbalanced, diseased, or damaged organism.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gas Processing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining natural gas into products of value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Male Sex
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Interval Measurement Information Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that places a Quality of an Entity onto some interval scale having no true zero value.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Maximum Speed Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the highest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Powering Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to supply power to some Material Artifact.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: One Dimensional Extent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one dimension.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Motion Observation Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Motion of a specified object or class of objects.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Rectangular
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of having four sides and four 90 degree angles.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Machine Bearing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to constrain relative motion to only desired motion and reduces friction between moving parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electromagnetic Induction Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact that is used to produce electromotive force across an electrical conductor due to its dynamic interaction with a magnetic field.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fertilizer Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Enhancing Artifact Function that is realized in processes of supplying soilds or plant tissues with one or more plant nutrients essential to growth.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Bow
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Arrows.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Declarative Communication
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Washing Facility
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Facility that is designed to wash personnel or equipment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Torque
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Gold Color
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Color that resembles a yellow-orange Hue with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Hospitality Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of accommodation food and beverage meeting and events gaming entertainment and recreation tourism services and visitor information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Agent Capability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Farm
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Agricultural Facility that is designed to produce food and other crops.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Medical Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed for diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease, disability, or death.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Electronic Cash
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of Bytes.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Fire Station
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Public Safety Facility that is designed for the storage of firefighting apparatus.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Opacity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer instead of reflecting, scattering, or absorbing electromangentic radiation of that frequency.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Filter Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process where entities of a specific type or which have specified properties enter it or pass through it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Center of Mass
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Fiat Point that is where the weighted position vectors of the distributed Mass of a Material Entity relative to this point sum to zero.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Media Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An information content entity presented in a canonical media format.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Certificate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Academic Degree
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Certificate issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Image
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Chart
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Image that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Database
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that is designed to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity whose parts are the subject of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Code List
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A List whose parts are Code Identifiers.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Video
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that contains a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that is relatively brief and designed to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Warning Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Message that describes a possible or impending threat.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Email Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Notification Message
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Message that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Barcode
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that represents one or more geometric shapes that have, as part, some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Information Line
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content entity consisting of a single line or row in some Document Content entity of which it is a part.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Document Field Content
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that is a part of some document content entity, and which  prescribes the eliciation of information to be written or selected within the document content entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Document Content Entity
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Media Content Entity that consists of a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams that are intended to be carried by physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Book
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as ink on paper or parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Transcript
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Spreadsheet
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as a interactive, tabular form.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Report
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Form Document
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content Entity that has Document Field Contents as parts.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Journal Article
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Document Content Entity that is part of a Journal Issue.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Explosive Mine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be concealed and to detonate as its target passes near it.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Explosive Naval Mine
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed on or under water.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Display Instrument
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Image Display Artifact Function.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Image Display Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to display an Image.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Email Address
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Designative Name created in order to identify some Email Box as the destination of an email message for the purpose of Email Messaging.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Employment
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sensor Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used in a process wherein an attribute of its bearer acts as a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sensor Platform Role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used to support or convey a Sensor during its deployment and functioning.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Sensing Process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Process that realizes a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Publishing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving the preparation and public issuance of information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Issuing
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Communication Transmission Artifact Function
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of sending information.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Refrain
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A Planned Act in which some Agent avoids or stops themselves from participating in some Planned Act.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: Act of Censuring
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: has realization
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: b has realization c =Def c realizes b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: realizes
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: (Elucidation) realizes is a relation between a process b and realizable entity c such that c inheres in some d & for all t, if b has participant d then c exists & the type instantiated by b is correlated with the type instantiated by c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: participates in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: (Elucidation) participates in holds between some b that is either a specifically dependent continuant or generically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region & some process p such that b participates in p some way

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: has participant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: p has participant c =Def c participates in p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: is concretized by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: c is concretized by b =Def b concretizes c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: concretizes
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: b concretizes c =Def b is a process or a specifically dependent continuant & c is a generically dependent continuant & there is some time t such that c is the pattern or content which b shares at t with actual or potential copies

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: preceded by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: b preceded by c =Def b precedes c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: precedes
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: (Elucidation) precedes is a relation between occurrents o, o' such that if t is the temporal extent of o & t' is the temporal extent of o' then either the last instant of o is before the first instant of o' or the last instant of o is the first instant of o' & neither o nor o' are temporal instants

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: occurs in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: b occurs in c =Def b is a process or a process boundary & c is a material entity or site & there exists a spatiotemporal region r & b occupies spatiotemporal region r & for all time t, if b exists at t then c exists at t & there exist spatial regions s and s' where b spatially projects onto s at t & c occupies spatial region s' at t & s is a continuant part of s' at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: generically depends on
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: b generically depends on c =Def b is a generically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & at some time t there inheres in c a specifically dependent continuant which concretizes b at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: is carrier of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b is carrier of c =Def there is some time t such that c generically depends on b at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: exists at
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: (Elucidation) exists at is a relation between a particular and some temporal region at which the particular exists

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: has member part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b has member part c =Def c member part of b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: has occurrent part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b has occurrent part c =Def c occurrent part of b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: has temporal part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: location of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b location of c =Def c located in b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: material basis of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b material basis of c =Def c has material basis b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: member part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b member part of c =Def b is an object & c is a material entity & there is some time t such that b continuant part of c at t & there is a mutually exhaustive and pairwise disjoint partition of c into objects x1, ..., xn (for some n ≠ 1) with b = xi (for some 1 <= i <= n)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: occurrent part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: (Elucidation) occurrent part of is a relation between occurrents b and c when b is part of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: temporal part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b temporal part of c =Def b occurrent part of c & (b and c are temporal regions) or (b and c are spatiotemporal regions & b temporally projects onto an occurrent part of the temporal region that c temporally projects onto) or (b and c are processes or process boundaries & b occupies a temporal region that is an occurrent part of the temporal region that c occupies)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: temporally projects onto
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: (Elucidation) temporally projects onto is a relation between a spatiotemporal region s and some temporal region which is the temporal extent of s

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: located in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b located in c =Def b is an independent continuant & c is an independent & neither is a spatial region & there is some time t such that the spatial region which b occupies at t is continuant part of the spatial region which c occupies at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: continuant part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b continuant part of c =Def b and c are continuants & there is some time t such that b and c exist at t & b continuant part of c at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: has continuant part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b has continuant part c =Def c continuant part of b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: environs
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b environs c =Def c occurs in b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: history of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: (Elucidation) history of is a relation between history b and material entity c such that b is the unique history of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: has history
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b has history c =Def c history of b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: specifically depended on by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b specifically depended on by c =Def c specifically depends on b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: specifically depends on
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: (Elucidation) specifically depends on is a relation between a specifically dependent continuant b and specifically dependent continuant or independent continuant that is not a spatial region c such that b and c share no parts in common & b is of a nature such that at all times t it cannot exist unless c exists & b is not a boundary of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: bearer of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b bearer of c =Def c inheres in b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: inheres in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: b inheres in c =Def b is a specifically dependent continuant & c is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & b specifically depends on c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.label: occupies temporal region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00001.definition: p occupies temporal region t =Def p is a process or process boundary & the spatiotemporal region occupied by p temporally projects onto t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: occupies spatiotemporal region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: (Elucidation) occupies spatiotemporal region is a relation between a process or process boundary p and the spatiotemporal region s which is its spatiotemporal extent

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: occupies spatial region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: b occupies spatial region r =Def b is an independent continuant that is not a spatial region & r is a spatial region & there is some time t such that every continuant part of b occupies some continuant part of r at t and no continuant part of b occupies any spatial region that is not a continuant part of r at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: spatially projects onto
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: (Elucidation) spatially projects onto is a relation between some spatiotemporal region b and spatial region c such that at some time t, c is the spatial extent of b at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: has material basis
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: b has material basis c =Def b is a disposition & c is a material entity & there is some d bearer of b & there is some time t such that c is a continuant part of d at t & d has disposition b because c is a continuant part of d at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: first instant of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: t first instant of t' =Def t is a temporal instant & t' is a temporal region t' & t precedes all temporal parts of t' other than t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: has first instant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: t has first instant t' =Def t' first instant of t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: last instant of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: t last instant of t' =Def t is a temporal instant & t' is a temporal region & all temporal parts of t' other than t precede t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.label: has last instant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00002.definition: t has last instant t' =Def t' last instant of t

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is successor of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is successor of y =Def y is predecessor of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has process part
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has process part y =Def y is part of process x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has object
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has object y =Def y is object of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has inside instant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has_inside_instant y iff x is an instance of One Dimensional Temporal Region and y is an instance of Temporal Instant and y is_inside_instant_of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has all members located in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has all members located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and every member of x is located in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: agent in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x agent_in y iff y is an instance of Process and x is an instance of Agent, such that x is causally active in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: coincides with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x coincides_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and y is a spatial part of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has subsidiary
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has subsidiary y =Def y is subsidiary of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has inside interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has inside interval y =Def y interval during x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: tangential part of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x tangential_part_of y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and there exists an instance of Immaterial Entity z such that z externally connects with x and z externally connects with y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: partially overlaps with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x partially overlaps with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x overlaps with y and x is not a spatial part of y and y is not a spatial part of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is supervised by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_supervised_by y iff x and y are both instances of Person and y supervises x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: role of aggregate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x role_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Role, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: prohibits
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x prohibits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must not occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is subject of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is subject of y =Def y is about x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is cause of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_cause_of y iff x and y are instances of Process, and y is a consequence of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is disrupted by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is disrupted by y =Def y disrupts x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is required by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is required by y =Def y requires x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is about
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_about y is a primitive relationship between an instance of Information Content Entity x and an instance of Entity y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: inheres in aggregate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x inheres_in_aggregate y iff x is an instance of Specifically Dependent Continuant or Generically Dependent Continuant and y is an instance of Object Aggregate and y aggregate_bearer_of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: connected with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_connected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there exists an instance of Immaterial Entity z that is part of both x and y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is an ordinal measurement of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_an_ordinal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_ordinal x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses y iff x is an instance of an Agent and y is an instance of a Material Entity, such that both x and y participate in some instance of a Process wherein x attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval finishes
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_finishes y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of x, w is the ending instant of both x and y, z is the starting instant of y, and z is before v.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is subsidiary of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_subsidiary_of y iff x and y are both instances of Organization and y controls x by having the capacity to determine the outcome of decisions about the financial and operating policies of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is output of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is output of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and the presence of x at the end of y is a necessary condition for the completion of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is prohibited by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is prohibited by y =Def y prohibits x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: caused by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x caused by y =Def y is cause of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval finished by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval finished by y =Def y interval finishes x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval equals
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_equals y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w and z such that w is the starting instant of both x and y and z is the ending instant of both x and y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is excerpted from
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: An Information Bearing Entity b1 is excerpted from another Information Bearing Entity B2 iff b1 is part of some Information Bearing Entity B1 that is carrier of some Information Content Entity C1, B2 is carrier of some Information Content Entity C2, C1 is not identical with C2, b1 is carrier of some Information Content Entity c1, b2 is an Information Bearing Entity that is part of B2 and b2 is carrier of c1 (i.e. the same Information Content Entity as borne by b1).

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval overlaps
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval overlaps y =Def y interval overlapped by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: nontangential part of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x nontangential_part_of y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x is a spatial part of y and there does not exist an instance of Immaterial Entity z such that z externally connects with x and z externally connects with y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: disposition of aggregate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x disposition_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Disposition, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has accomplice
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has accomplice y =Def y accomplice in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is subordinate role to
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: For all x,y,t: y is subordinate role to x at t iff: x is an instance of Role at time t, and y is an instance of Role at time t, and there is some z such that x is realized by z and z is an instance of Process which creates, modifies, transfers, or eliminates some u such that u is a Process Regulation at time t, and u is addressed to the bearer of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has some member located in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has some member located in y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of independent continuant but not a spatial region, and at least one member of x is located in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has agent
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has agent y =Def y agent in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: affects
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x affects y =Def y is affected by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: aggregate bearer of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x aggregate bearer of y =Def y inheres in aggregate x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: time zone identifier used by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x time_zone_identifier_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Time Zone Identifier, such that x designates the spatial region associated with the time zone mentioned in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: disconnected with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x disconnected_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and there does not exist some immaterial entity z that is part of both x and y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is input of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is input of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and the presence of x at the beginning of y is a necessary condition for the start of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has sender
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has sender y =Def y sends x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is site of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is site of y =Def y occurs at x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is organizational context of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_organizational_context_of y iff x is an instance of an Organization and y is an instance of a Role and z is an instance of a Person, such that z's affiliation with x is a prerequisite for z bearing y, or x ascribes y to the bearer of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval is after
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval is after y =Def y interval is before x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is inside instant of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_inside_instant of y iff x is an instance of Temporal Instant and y is an instance of One-Dimensional Temporal Region and there are instances of Temporal Instant w and z that are part of y and non-identical to x such that w precedes x and z is preceded by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: accessory in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_accessory_in y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Process such that x assists another instance of Agent z in the commission of y, and x was not located at the location of y when y occurred, and x is not an agent_in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has spatial part
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has spatial part y =Def y spatial part of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is part of process
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is part of process y iff x is occurrent part of y, x and y are Processes, and x occupies a temporal region that is a proper occurrent part of the temporal interval of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is delimited by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_delimited_by y iff x is an instance of Organization and y is an instance of Delimiting Domain and y delimits x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval disjoint
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_disjoint y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and have no parts in common.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses measurement unit
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses measurement unit y =Def y is measurement unit of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: delimits
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x delimits y =Def y is delimited by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is interest of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is interest of y =Def y has interest in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is a nominal measurement of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_a_nominal_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x classifies y relative to some set of shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristics.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval during
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_during y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant u, v, w, and z such that u is the starting instant of x, v is the ending instant of x, w is the starting instant of y, z is the ending instant of y, w is before u, and v is before z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval overlapped by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_overlapped_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_overlaps x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: represented by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x represented by y =Def y represents x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is temporal region of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is temporal region of y =Def y occupies temporal region x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval started by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval started by y =Def y interval starts x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is an interval measurement of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_an_interval_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Interval Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and y is_measured_by_interval x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is mention of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is mention of y =Def y is mentioned by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: designated by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x designated by y =Def y designates x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: capability of aggregate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x capability_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in aggregate y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: condition described by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x condition described by y =Def y describes condition x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is affected by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is affected by y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and y influences x in some manner, most often by producing a change in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: disrupts
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A relation where one process disrupts another process from occurring as it would have.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: capability of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x capability_of y iff y is an instance of Agent and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: instant is after
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x instant_is_after y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Instant and there exists some instance of Temporal Interval z such that y is the starting instant of z and x is the ending instant of z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: accomplice in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: Agent x is accomplice_in Process y iff x assists in the commission of y, is located at the location of y, but is not agent_in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval meets
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval meets y =Def y interval met by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: aggregate has capability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x aggregate has capability y =Def y capability of aggregate x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: language used in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x language_used_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Language, such that the literal value of y is a string that is encoded according to the syntax of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is geospatial coordinate reference system of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_geospatial_coordinate_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Geospatial Coordinate Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: aggregate has role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x aggregate_has_role y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Role, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measured by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is measured by y =Def y is a measurement of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: aggregate has quality
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x aggregate_has_quality y iff x is an instance of Object Aggregate and y is an instance of Quality, such that x aggregate_bearer_of y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses time zone identifier
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses time zone identifier y =Def y time zone identifier used by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has tangential part
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has tangential part y =Def y tangential part of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: permits
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x permits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that y may occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses reference system
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses reference system y =Def y is reference system of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses geospatial coordinate reference system
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses geospatial coordinate reference system y =Def y is geospatial coordinate reference system of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measured by nominal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is measured by nominal y =Def y is a nominal measurement of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval met by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_met_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_meets x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: designates
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x designates y iff x is an instance of a Designative Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of an Entity, such that given some context, x uniquely distinguishes y from other entities.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: described by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x described by y =Def y describes x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: occurs at
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x occurs_at y iff x is an instance of Process and y is an instance of Site, such that x occurs in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is mentioned by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_mentioned_by y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Entity, such that y is used as a reference to x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: prescribed by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x prescribed by y =Def y prescribes x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has input
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has input y =Def y is input of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has recipient
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has recipient y =Def y receives x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval starts
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_starts y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant v, w, and z such that v is the starting instant of both x and y, w is the ending instant of x, z is the ending instant of y and w is before z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval contains
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval contains y =Def y interval contained by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is used by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is used by y =Def y uses x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is predecessor of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_predecessor_of y iff x and y are both instances of Independent Continuant and there is some process p and x is an input to p and y is an output of p.
