https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: externally connects with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x externally_connects_with y iff x and y are both instances of Immaterial Entity and x connects with y and x does not overlap y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: process starts
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x process_starts y iff x and y are instances of processes, and x is_cause_of y, and i is an instance of a temporal instant, and r is an instance of a temporal interval, and y has starting instance i, and x occupies temporal region r, and r has inside instant i.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is object of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is object of y =Def x participates in y, x is an Independent Continuant (but not a Spatial Region), y is a Process, and y is performed by Agent z and x is part of the projected state that z intends to achieve by performing y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: represents
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x represents y iff x is an instance of Representational Information Content Entity, y is an instance of Entity, and z is carrier of x, such that x is about y in virtue of there existing an isomorphism between characteristics of z and y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is affiliated with
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_affiliated_with y iff x and y are instances of Agent, such that they have any kind of social or business relationship.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval is before
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and there exist instances of Temporal Instant w, z such that w is the ending instant of x and z is the starting instant of y and w is before z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: prescribes
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: supervises
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x supervises y =Def y is supervised by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: spatial part of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x spatial_part_of y iff x, y, z, and q are instances of Immaterial Entity, such that for any z connected with x, z is also connected with y, and q is connected with y but not connected with x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: quality of aggregate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x quality_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Quality, and x inheres_in_aggregate y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has accessory
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has accessory y =Def y accessory in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has subordinate role
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has subordinate role y =Def y is subordinate role to x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has capability
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has capability y =Def y capability of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: aggregate has disposition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x aggregate has disposition y =Def y disposition of aggregate x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: inhibits
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x inhibits y =Def y is inhibited by x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measurement unit of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_measurement_unit_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Measurement Unit, such that x describes the magnitude of measured physical quantity mentioned in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: process started by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x process started by y =Def y process starts x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measured by ordinal
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is measured by ordinal y =Def y is a ordinal measurement of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measured by interval
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is measured by interval y =Def y is a interval measurement of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is measured by ratio
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is measured by ratio y =Def y is a ratio measurement of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is a measurement of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_a_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x describes some attribute of y relative to some scale or classification scheme.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: inhibited by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: y inhibited_by x iff x and y are non-identical Processes, d is a Decrease of Realizable Entity, and x is_cause_of d, and r is a Realizable Entity, and d has_participant r, and r realized_in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: interval contained by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x interval_contained_by y iff x and y are both instances of Temporal Interval and y interval_contains x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: requires
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x requires y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must occur.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: uses language
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x uses language y =Def y language used in x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has affiliate
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has affiliate y =Def y is affiliated with x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: receives
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x receives y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the recipient and decoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: describes condition
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: p describes_condition c iff p is an instance of a Performance Specification and c is an instance of Entity and p has part d, and d is an instance of a Descriptive Information Content Entity, and p prescribes an entity s, and d describes c, and c is an entity that is causally relevant to s existing as prescribed by p.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: describes
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x describes y iff x is an instance of Descriptive Information Content Entity, and y is an instance of Entity, such that x is_about the characteristics that identify y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is a ratio measurement of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_a_ratio_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity and x describes some attribute of y relative to a scale having equal unit values and a zero value that corresponds to the absence of the attribute being measured.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has interest in
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: A relation between an Agent and some Process where the Agent has an interest in that Process.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has output
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has output y =Def y is output of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has nontangential part
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has nontangential part y =Def y nontangential part of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: instant is before
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x instant_is_before y iff x and y are both instances of Zero Dimensional Temporal Region and there exists some instance of Temporal Interval z such that x is the starting instant of z and y is the ending instant of z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: has organizational context
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x has organizational context y =Def y is organizational context of x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: sends
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x sends y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the initiator and encoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is reference system of
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is_reference_system_of y iff y is an instance of Information Bearing Entity and x is an instance of Reference System, such that x describes the set of standards mentioned in y.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: is permitted by
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x is permitted by y =Def y permits x.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: process has first instant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x process_has_first_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is first_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z.

https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.label: process has last instant
https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont.definition: x process_has_last_instant y Def= x is a Process, y is a Temporal Instant, and there is some Temporal Region z such that y is last_instant_of z, and x occupies_temporal_region z.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: a core relation that holds between a part and its whole

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: has part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: a core relation that holds between a whole and its part

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.label: contains process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_00000.definition: [copied from inverse property 'occurs in'] b occurs_in c =def b is a process and c is a material entity or immaterial entity& there exists a spatiotemporal region r and b occupies_spatiotemporal_region r.& forall(t) if b exists_at t then c exists_at t & there exist spatial regions s and s’ where & b spatially_projects_onto s at t& c is occupies_spatial_region s’ at t& s is a proper_continuant_part_of s’ at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_0100.label: derives from part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_0100.definition: A relation between two distinct material entities, the new entity and the old entity, in which the new entity begins to exist through the separation or transformation of a part of the old entity, and the new entity inherits a significant portion of the matter belonging to that part of the old entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_0200.label: has increased levels of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_0200.definition: A has part relationship between a whole and a part, where the number of parts present in the whole is higher than in comparable entities.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.label: characteristic of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.definition: a relation between a specifically dependent continuant (the characteristic) and any other entity (the bearer), in which the characteristic depends on the bearer for its existence.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.label: participates in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.definition: a relation between a continuant and a process, in which the continuant is somehow involved in the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.label: has participant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.definition: a relation between a process and a continuant, in which the continuant is somehow involved in the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.label: is concretized as
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.definition: A relationship between a generically dependent continuant and a specifically dependent continuant or process, in which the generically dependent continuant depends on some independent continuant or process in virtue of the fact that the specifically dependent continuant or process also depends on that same independent continuant. A generically dependent continuant may be concretized as multiple specifically dependent continuants or processes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.label: concretizes
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000005.definition: A relationship between a specifically dependent continuant or process and a generically dependent continuant, in which the generically dependent continuant depends on some independent continuant in virtue of the fact that the specifically dependent continuant or process also depends on that same independent continuant. Multiple specifically dependent continuants or processes can concretize the same generically dependent continuant.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000007.label: function of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000007.definition: a relation between a function and an independent continuant (the bearer), in which the function specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.label: quality of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.definition: a relation between a quality and an independent continuant (the bearer), in which the quality specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.label: role of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.definition: a relation between a role and an independent continuant (the bearer), in which the role specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.label: has function
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.definition: a relation between an independent continuant (the bearer) and a function, in which the function specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.label: has quality
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.definition: a relation between an independent continuant (the bearer) and a quality, in which the quality specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.label: has role
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000008.definition: a relation between an independent continuant (the bearer) and a role, in which the role specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000009.label: has disposition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000009.definition: a relation between an independent continuant (the bearer) and a disposition, in which the disposition specifically depends on the bearer for its existence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.label: obsolete in neural circuit with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.definition: OBSOLETE A relation that holds between two neurons connected directly via a synapse, or indirectly via a series of synaptically connected neurons.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.label: obsolete upstream in neural circuit with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.definition: OBSOLETE A relation that holds between a neuron that is synapsed_to another neuron or a neuron that is connected indirectly to another by a chain of neurons, each synapsed_to the next, in which the direction is from the last to the first.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.label: obsolete downstream in neural circuit with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000030.definition: OBSOLETE A relation that holds between a neuron that is synapsed_by another neuron or a neuron that is connected indirectly to another by a chain of neurons, each synapsed_by the next, in which the direction is from the last to the first.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000100.label: derives from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000100.definition: a relation between two distinct material entities, the new entity and the old entity, in which the new entity begins to exist when the old entity ceases to exist, and the new entity inherits the significant portion of the matter of the old entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000100.label: derives into
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000100.definition: a relation between two distinct material entities, the old entity and the new entity, in which the new entity begins to exist when the old entity ceases to exist, and the new entity inherits the significant portion of the matter of the old entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000101.label: location of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000101.definition: a relation between two independent continuants, the location and the target, in which the target is entirely within the location

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.label: is allergic trigger for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.definition: A relation between a material entity and a condition (a phenotype or disease) of a host, in which the material entity is not part of the host, and is considered harmless to non-allergic hosts, and the condition results in pathological processes that include an abnormally strong immune response against the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.label: is autoimmune trigger for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.definition: A relation between a material entity and a condition (a phenotype or disease) of a host, in which the material entity is part of the host itself, and the condition results in pathological processes that include an abnormally strong immune response against the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.label: has allergic trigger
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.definition: A relation between a condition (a phenotype or disease) of a host and a material entity, in which the material entity is not part of the host, and is considered harmless to non-allergic hosts, and the condition results in pathological processes that include an abnormally strong immune response against the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.label: has autoimmune trigger
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.definition: A relation between a condition (a phenotype or disease) of a host and a material entity, in which the material entity is part of the host itself, and the condition results in pathological processes that include an abnormally strong immune response against the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.label: located in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000102.definition: a relation between two independent continuants, the target and the location, in which the target is entirely within the location

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: 2D boundary of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: a relation between a 2D immaterial entity (the boundary) and a material entity, in which the boundary delimits the material entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: has 2D boundary
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: a relation between a material entity and a 2D immaterial entity (the boundary), in which the boundary delimits the material entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: electrically_synapsed_to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: A relation that holds between two neurons that are electrically coupled via gap junctions.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: tracheates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: The relationship that holds between a trachea or tracheole and an antomical structure that is contained in (and so provides an oxygen supply to).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: innervated by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: relation between an anatomical structure and a neuron projection bundle that has synaptic terminals in the structure.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: bounding layer of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition:
X outer_layer_of Y iff:
. X :continuant that bearer_of some PATO:laminar
. X part_of Y
. exists Z :surface
. X has_boundary Z
. Z boundary_of Y

has_boundary: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002002
boundary_of: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002000

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: coincident with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: A relation that holds between two linear structures that are approximately parallel to each other for their entire length and where either the two structures are adjacent to each other or one is part of the other.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.label: cell expresses
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000200.definition: A relation that applies between a cell(c) and a gene(g) , where the process of 'transcription, DNA templated (GO_0006351)' is occuring in in cell c and that process has input gene g.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: regulates in another organism
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: x 'regulates in other organism' y if and only if: (x is the realization of a function to exert an effect on the frequency, rate or extent of y) AND (the agents of x are produced by organism o1 and the agents of y are produced by organism o2).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: regulates transport of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A relationship that holds between a  process that regulates a transport process and the entity transported by that process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: occurrent part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A part of relation that applies only between occurrents.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: has regulatory component activity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A 'has regulatory component activity' B if A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674), A has_component B and A is regulated by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: has negative regulatory component activity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A relationship that holds between a GO molecular function and a component of that molecular function that negatively regulates the activity of the whole.  More formally, A 'has regulatory component activity' B iff :A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674), A has_component B and A is negatively regulated by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: has positive regulatory component activity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A relationship that holds between a GO molecular function and a component of that molecular function that positively regulates the activity of the whole.  More formally, A 'has regulatory component activity' B iff :A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674), A has_component B and A is positively regulated by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: has component process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: w 'has process component' p if p and w are processes,  w 'has part' p and w is such that it can be directly disassembled into into n parts p, p2, p3, ..., pn, where these parts are of similar type.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.label: has ligand
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000201.definition: A relationship that holds between between a receptor and an chemical entity, typically a small molecule or peptide, that carries information between cells or compartments of a cell and which binds the receptor and regulates its effector function.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: transports
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.definition: Holds between p and c when p is a transport process or transporter activity and the outcome of this p is to move c from one location to another.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: occurs across
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.definition: A relationship between a process and a barrier, where the process occurs in a region spanning the barrier. For cellular processes the barrier is typically a membrane. Examples include transport across a membrane and membrane depolarization.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: directly negatively regulated by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.definition: Process(P2) is directly negatively regulated by process(P1) iff: P1 negatively regulates P2 via direct physical interaction between an agent executing P1 (or some part of P1) and an agent executing P2 (or some part of P2).  For example, if protein A has protein binding activity(P1) that targets protein B and this binding  negatively regulates the kinase activity (P2) of protein B then P2 directly negatively regulated by P1.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: directly positively regulated by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.definition: Process(P2) is directly postively regulated by process(P1) iff: P1 positively regulates P2 via direct physical interaction between an agent executing P1 (or some part of P1) and an agent executing P2 (or some part of P2).  For example, if protein A has protein binding activity(P1) that targets protein B and this binding positively regulates the kinase activity (P2) of protein B then P2 is directly postively regulated by P1.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: has effector activity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.definition: A 'has effector activity' B if A and B are GO molecular functions (GO_0003674),  A 'has component activity' B and B is the effector (output function) of B.  Each compound function has only one effector activity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000202.label: in register with

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000208.label: simultaneous with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000208.definition: x simultaneous with y iff ω(x) = ω(y) and ω(α ) = ω(α), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point and '=' indicates the same instance in time.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: has soma location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Relation between a neuron and a material anatomical entity that its soma is part of.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: fasciculates with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: relationship between a neuron and a neuron projection bundle (e.g.- tract or nerve bundle) that one or more of its projections travels through.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: axon synapses in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Relation between a neuron and some structure its axon forms (chemical) synapses in.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Relation between an anatomical structure (including cells) and a neuron that chemically synapses to it.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: has plasma membrane part
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Holds between a cell c and a protein complex or protein p if and only if that cell has as part a plasma_membrane[GO:0005886], and that plasma membrane has p as part.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed_via_type_Ib_bouton_to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: A relation between a motor neuron and a muscle that it synapses to via a type Ib bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed_via_type_Is_bouton_to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: A relation between a motor neuron and a muscle that it synapses to via a type Is bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed_via_type_II_bouton_to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: A relation between a motor neuron and a muscle that it synapses to via a type II bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed_by_via_type_II_bouton
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Relation between a muscle and a motor neuron that synapses to it via a type II bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.label: synapsed_by_via_type_Ib_bouton
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000210.definition: Relation between a muscle and a motor neuron that synapses to it via a type Ib bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.label: has postsynaptic terminal in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.definition: Relation between a neuron and some structure (e.g.- a brain region) in which it receives (chemical) synaptic input.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.label: synapsed_by_via_type_Is_bouton
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.definition: Relation between a muscle and a motor neuron that synapses to it via a type Is bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.label: has presynaptic terminal in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.definition: Relation between a neuron and some structure (e.g.- a brain region) in which it receives (chemical) synaptic input.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.label: synapsed_via_type_III_bouton_to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.definition: A relation between a motor neuron and a muscle that it synapses to via a type III bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.label: synapsed_by_via_type_III_bouton
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000211.definition: Relation between a muscle and a motor neuron that synapses to it via a type III bouton.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000212.label: synapsed to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000212.definition: Relation between a neuron and an anatomical structure (including cells) that it chemically synapses to.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000212.label: dendrite synapsed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000212.definition: Relation between a neuron and some structure  (e.g.- a brain region) in which its dendrite receives synaptic input.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.label: has synaptic terminal in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.definition: A general relation between a neuron and some structure in which it either chemically synapses to some target or in which it receives (chemical) synaptic input.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.label: overlaps
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.definition: x overlaps y if and only if there exists some z such that x has part z and z part of y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.label: has fasciculating neuron projection
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.definition: The relation between a neuron projection bundle and a neuron projection that is fasciculated with it.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.label: innervates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000213.definition:
Relation between a 'neuron projection bundle' and a region in which one or more of its component neuron projections either synapses to targets or receives synaptic input.
T innervates some R
Expands_to: T has_fasciculating_neuron_projection that synapse_in some R.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.label: continuous with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.definition: X continuous_with Y if and only if X and Y share a fiat boundary.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.label: partially overlaps
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.definition: x partially overlaps y iff there exists some z such that z is part of x and z is part of y, and it is also the case that neither x is part of y or y is part of x

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.label: derived by descent from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.definition: d derived_by_descent_from a if d is specified by some genetic program that is sequence-inherited-from a genetic program that specifies a.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.label: has derived by descendant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.definition: inverse of derived by descent from

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.label: shares ancestor with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000215.definition: two individual entities d1 and d2 stand in a shares_ancestor_with relation if and only if there exists some a such that d1 derived_by_descent_from a and d2 derived_by_descent_from a.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.label: obsolete only in taxon
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.definition: OBSOLETE. x only in taxon y if and only if x is in taxon y, and there is no other organism z such that y!=z and x is in taxon z.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.label: in taxon
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.definition: x is in taxon y if an only if y is an organism, and the relationship between x and y is one of: part of (reflexive), developmentally preceded by, derives from, secreted by, expressed.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.label: spatially disjoint from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000216.definition: A is spatially_disjoint_from B if and only if they have no parts in common

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.label: connected to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.definition: a is connected to b if and only if a and b are discrete structure, and there exists some connecting structure c, such that c connects a and b

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.label: connects
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.definition: c connects a if and only if there exist some b such that a and b are similar parts of the same system, and c connects b, specifically, c connects a with b. When one structure connects two others it unites some aspect of the function or role they play within the system.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.label: attached to part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.definition: a is attached to part of b if a is attached to b, or a is attached to some p, where p is part of b.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.label: supplies
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.definition: Relation between an arterial structure and another structure, where the arterial structure acts as a conduit channeling fluid, substance or energy.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.label: drains
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000217.definition: Relation between an collecting structure and another structure, where the collecting structure acts as a conduit channeling fluid, substance or energy away from the other structure.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000218.label: has component
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000218.definition: w 'has component' p if w 'has part' p and w is such that it can be directly disassembled into into n parts p, p2, p3, ..., pn, where these parts are of similar type.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: has phenotype
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: A relationship that holds between a biological entity and a phenotype. Here a phenotype is construed broadly as any kind of quality of an organism part, a collection of these qualities, or a change in quality or qualities (e.g. abnormally increased temperature). The subject of this relationship can be an organism (where the organism has the phenotype, i.e. the qualities inhere in parts of this organism), a genomic entity such as a gene or genotype (if modifications of the gene or the genotype causes the phenotype), or a condition such as a disease (such that if the condition inheres in an organism, then the organism has the phenotype).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: develops from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: x develops from y if and only if either (a) x directly develops from y or (b) there exists some z such that x directly develops from z and z develops from y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: gene product of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: definition "x has gene product of y if and only if y is a gene (SO:0000704) that participates in some gene expression process (GO:0010467) where the output of that process is either y or something that is ribosomally translated from x"

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: has gene product
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: x has gene product y if and only if x is a gene (SO:0000704) that participates in some gene expression process (GO:0010467) where the output of that process is either y or something that is ribosomally translated from y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: expressed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: x expressed in y if and only if there is a gene expression process (GO:0010467) that occurs in y, and one of the following holds: (i) x is a gene, and x is transcribed into a transcript as part of the gene expression process (ii) x is a transcript, and the transcription of x is part of the gene expression process (iii) x is a mature gene product such as a protein, and x was translated or otherwise processes from a transcript that was transcribed as part of this gene expression process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: directly develops from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: Candidate definition: x directly_develops from y if and only if there exists some developmental process (GO:0032502) p such that x and y both participate in p, and x is the output of p and y is the input of p, and a substantial portion of the matter of x comes from y, and the start of x is coincident with or after the end of y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.label: parasitoid of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000220.definition: A parasite that kills or sterilizes its host

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: p regulates q iff p is causally upstream of q, the execution of p is not constant and varies according to specific conditions, and p influences the rate or magnitude of execution of q due to an effect either on some enabler of q or some enabler of a part of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: negatively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: p negatively regulates q iff p regulates q, and p decreases the rate or magnitude of execution of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: positively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: p positively regulates q iff p regulates q, and p increases the rate or magnitude of execution of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: has prototype
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: x has prototype y if and only if x is an instance of C and y is a prototypical instance of C. For example, every instance of heart, both normal and abnormal is related by the has prototype relation to some instance of a "canonical" heart, which participates in blood circulation.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: capable of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: A relation between a material entity (such as a cell) and a process, in which the material entity has the ability to carry out the process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: capable of part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: c stands in this relationship to p if and only if there exists some p' such that c is capable_of p', and p' is part_of p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: obsolete actively participates in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: OBSOLETE x actively participates in y if and only if x participates in y and x realizes some active role

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: obsolete has active participant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: OBSOLETE x has participant y if and only if x realizes some active role that inheres in y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.label: surrounded by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000221.definition: x surrounded_by y if and only if (1) x is adjacent to y and for every region r that is adjacent to x, r overlaps y (2) the shared boundary between x and y occupies the majority of the outermost boundary of x

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: adjacent to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: x adjacent to y if and only if x and y share a boundary.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: starts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: x starts with y if and only if x has part y and the time point at which x starts is equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: α(y) = α(x) ∧ ω(y) < ω(x), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: develops from part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: x develops from part of y if and only if there exists some z such that x develops from z and z is part of y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: develops in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: x develops_in y if x is located in y whilst x is developing

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: obligate parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: A sub-relation of parasite-of in which the parasite that cannot complete its life cycle without a host.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.label: facultative parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000222.definition: A sub-relations of parasite-of in which the parasite that can complete its life cycle independent of a host.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: ends with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: x ends with y if and only if x has part y and the time point at which x ends is equivalent to the time point at which y ends. Formally: α(y) > α(x) ∧ ω(y) = ω(x), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: has start location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: x 'has starts location' y if and only if there exists some process z such that x 'starts with' z and z 'occurs in' y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: has end location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: x 'has end location' y if and only if there exists some process z such that x 'ends with' z and z 'occurs in' y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: has input
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: p has input c iff: p is a process, c is a material entity, c is a participant in p, c is present at the start of p, and the state of c is modified during p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: has output
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: p has output c iff c is a participant in p, c is present at the end of p, and c is not present in the same state at the beginning of p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: stem parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: A parasite-of relationship in which the host is a plant and the parasite that attaches to the host stem (PO:0009047)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: root parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: A parasite-of relationship in which the host is a plant and the parasite that attaches to the host root (PO:0009005)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: hemiparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: A sub-relation of parasite-of in which the parasite is a plant, and the parasite is parasitic under natural conditions and is also photosynthetic to some degree. Hemiparasites may just obtain water and mineral nutrients from the host plant. Many obtain at least part of their organic nutrients from the host as well.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.label: has component participant
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000223.definition: X 'has component participant' Y means X 'has participant' Y and there is a cardinality constraint that specifies the numbers of Ys.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: has exposure receptor
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and any entity (e.g., an organism, organism population, or an organism part) that interacts with an exposure stimulus during the exposure event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: has exposure stressor
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and any agent, stimulus, activity, or event that causes stress or tension on an organism and interacts with an exposure receptor during an exposure event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: has exposure route
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and a process by which the exposure stressor comes into contact with the exposure receptor

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: has exposure transport path
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: A broad relationship between an exposure event or process and the course takes from the source to the target.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: related via exposure to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: Any relationship between an exposure event or process and any other entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: over-expressed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: g is over-expressed in t iff g is expressed in t, and the expression level of g is increased relative to some background.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: under-expressed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: g is under-expressed in t iff g is expressed in t, and the expression level of g is decreased relative to some background.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.label: has active ingredient
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000224.definition: A relationship that holds between a substance and a chemical entity, if the chemical entity is part of the substance, and the chemical entity forms the biologically active component of the substance.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.label: connecting branch of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.definition: b connecting-branch-of s iff b is connected to s, and there exists some tree-like structure t such that the mereological sum of b plus s is either the same as t or a branching-part-of t.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.label: has developmental contribution from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.definition: x has developmental contribution from y iff x has some part z such that z develops from y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.label: developmentally contributes to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.definition: inverse of has developmental contribution from

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.label: developmentally induced by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.definition: t1 induced_by t2 if there is a process of developmental induction (GO:0031128) with t1 and t2 as interacting participants. t2 causes t1 to change its fate from a precursor material anatomical entity type T to T', where T' develops_from T

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.label: developmentally preceded by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000225.definition: Candidate definition: x developmentally related to y if and only if there exists some developmental process (GO:0032502) p such that x and y both participates in p, and x is the output of p and y is the input of p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.label: has biological role
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.definition: c has-biological-role r iff c has-role r and r is a biological role (CHEBI:24432)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.label: has application role
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.definition: c has-application-role r iff c has-role r and r is an application role (CHEBI:33232)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.label: has chemical role
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.definition: c has-chemical-role r iff c has-role r and r is a chemical role (CHEBI:51086)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.label: acts upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.definition: c acts upstream of p if and only if c enables some f that is involved in p' and p' occurs chronologically before p, is not part of p, and affects the execution of p. c is a material entity and f, p, p' are processes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.label: acts upstream of or within
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000226.definition: c acts upstream of or within p if c is enables f, and f is causally upstream of or within p. c is a material entity and p is an process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000228.label: developmentally replaces
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000228.definition: x developmentally replaces y if and only if there is some developmental process that causes x to move or to cease to exist, and for the site that was occupied by x to become occupied by y, where y either comes into existence in this site or moves to this site from somewhere else

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: ubiquitously expressed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: x is ubiquitously expressed in y if and only if x is expressed in y, and the majority of cells in y express x

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: expresses
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: y expresses x if and only if there is a gene expression process (GO:0010467) that occurs in y, and one of the following holds: (i) x is a gene, and x is transcribed into a transcript as part of the gene expression process (ii) x is a transcript, and x was transcribed from a gene as part of the gene expression process (iii) x is a mature gene product (protein or RNA), and x was translated or otherwise processed from a transcript that was transcribed as part of the gene expression process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: results in developmental progression of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: p results in the developmental progression of s iff p is a developmental process and s is an anatomical entity and p causes s to undergo a change in state at some point along its natural developmental cycle (this cycle starts with its formation, through the mature structure, and ends with its loss).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: results in development of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: p 'results in development of' c if and only if p is a developmental process and p results in the state of c changing from its initial state as a primordium or anlage through its mature state and to its final state.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: results in formation of anatomical entity
results in morphogenesis of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: The relationship that links an entity with the process that results in the formation and shaping of that entity over time from an immature to a mature state.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.label: results in maturation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000229.definition: The relationship that links an entity with a process that results in the progression of the entity over time that is independent of changes in it's shape and results in an end point state of that entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.label: has habitat
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.definition: x 'has habitat' y if and only if: x is an organism, y is a habitat, and y can sustain and allow the growth of a population of xs.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.label: causally upstream of, positive effect
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.definition: p is causally upstream of, positive effect q iff p is casually upstream of q, and the execution of p is required for the execution of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.label: causally upstream of, negative effect
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.definition: p is causally upstream of, negative effect q iff p is casually upstream of q, and the execution of p decreases the execution of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.label: has exposure stimulus
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000230.definition: A relationship between an exposure event or process and any agent, stimulus, activity, or event that causally effects an organism and interacts with an exposure receptor during an exposure event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.label: transports or maintains localization of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.definition: Holds between p and c when p is a localization process (localization covers maintenance of localization as well as its establishment)  and the outcome of this process is to regulate the localization of c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.label: characteristic of part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.definition: q characteristic of part of w if and only if there exists some p such that q inheres in p and p part of w.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.label: results in acquisition of features of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000231.definition: The relationship that links a specified entity with the process that results in an unspecified entity acquiring the features and characteristics of the specified entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: evolutionarily related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: A relationship that holds via some environmental process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: ecologically related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: A relationship that is mediated in some way by the environment or environmental feature (ENVO:00002297)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: mereotopologically related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: A mereological relationship or a topological relationship

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: developmentally related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: A relationship that holds between entities participating in some developmental process (GO:0032502)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: colocalizes with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: a colocalizes_with b if and only if  a is transiently or peripherally associated with b[GO].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: enables
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: c enables p iff c is capable of p and c acts to execute p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: functionally related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: A grouping relationship for any relationship directly involving a function, or that holds because of a function of one of the related entities.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.label: part of structure that is capable of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000232.definition: this relation holds between c and p when c is part of some c', and c' is capable of p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: genomically related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: holds between two entities when some genome-level process such as gene expression is involved. This includes transcriptional, spliceosomal events. These relations can be used between either macromolecule entities (such as regions of nucleic acid) or between their abstract informational counterparts.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: involved in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: c involved_in p if and only if c enables some process p', and p' is part of p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: regulates levels of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: p regulates levels of c if p regulates some amount (PATO:0000070) of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: related via localization to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: A relationship that holds via some process of localization

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: has target start location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: This relationship holds between p and l when p is a transport or localization process in which the outcome is to move some cargo c from some initial location l to some destination.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.label: has target end location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000233.definition: This relationship holds between p and l when p is a transport or localization process in which the outcome is to move some cargo c from a an initial location to some destination l.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: imports
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: Holds between p and c when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c to a destination that is part of some s, where the start location of c is part of the region that surrounds s.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: results in transport along
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: Holds between p and l when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c from one location to another, and the route taken by c follows a path that is aligned_with l

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: results in transport across
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: Holds between p and m when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c from one location to another, and the route taken by c follows a path that crosses m.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: results in transport to from or in
exports
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: Holds between p and c when p is a transportation or localization process and the outcome of this process is to move c to a destination that is part of some s, where the end location of c is part of the region that surrounds s.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: results in commitment to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: p 'results in commitment to' c if and only if p is a developmental process and c is a cell and p results in the state of c changing such that is can only develop into a single cell type.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.label: results in determination of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000234.definition: p 'results in determination of' c if and only if p is a developmental process and c is a cell and p results in the state of c changing to be determined. Once a cell becomes determined, it becomes committed to differentiate down a particular pathway regardless of its environment.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.label: member of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.definition: is member of is a mereological relation between a item and a collection.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.label: has member
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.definition: has member is a mereological relation between a collection and an item.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.label: results in structural organization of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.definition: A relationship between a process and an anatomical entity such that the process contributes to the act of creating the structural organization of the anatomical entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.label: results in specification of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.definition: The relationship linking a cell and its participation in a process that results in the fate of the cell being specified. Once specification has taken place, a cell will be committed to differentiate down a specific pathway if left in its normal environment.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.label: results in developmental induction of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000235.definition: p results in developmental induction of c if and only if p is a collection of cell-cell signaling processes that signal to a neighbouring tissue that is the precursor of the mature c, where the signaling results in the commitment to cell types necessary for the formation of c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: attached to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: a is attached to b if and only if a and b are discrete objects or object parts, and there are physical connections between a and b such that a force pulling a will move b, or a force pulling b will move a

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: has muscle origin
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: m has_muscle_origin s iff m is attached_to s, and it is the case that when m contracts, s does not move. The site of the origin tends to be more proximal and have greater mass than what the other end attaches to.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: has muscle insertion
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: m has_muscle_insertion s iff m is attaches_to s, and it is the case that when m contracts, s moves. Insertions are usually connections of muscle via tendon to bone.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: derived from ancestral fusion of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: x has_fused_element y iff: there exists some z : x has_part z, z homologous_to y, and y is a distinct element, the boundary between x and z is largely fiat

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: in branching relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: A relationship that holds between two material entities in a system of connected structures, where the branching relationship holds based on properties of the connecting network.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: tributary of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: x tributary_of y if and only if x a channel for the flow of a substance into y, where y is larger than x. If x and y are hydrographic features, then y is the main stem of a river, or a lake or bay, but not the sea or ocean. If x and y are anatomical, then y is a vein.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: distributary of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: x distributary_of y if and only if x is capable of channeling the flow of a substance to y, where y channels less of the substance than x

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: anabranch of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: x anabranch_of y if x is a distributary of y (i.e. it channels a from a larger flow from y) and x ultimately channels the flow back into y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.label: spatially coextensive with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000237.definition: x spatially_coextensive_with y if and inly if x and y have the same location

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: branching part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x is a branching part of y if and only if x is part of y and x is connected directly or indirectly to the main stem of y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: main stem of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x main_stem_of y if y is a branching structure and x is a channel that traces a linear path through y, such that x has higher capacity than any other such path.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: proper distributary of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x proper_distributary_of y iff x distributary_of y and x does not flow back into y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: proper tributary of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x proper_tributary_of y iff x tributary_of y and x does not originate from y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: has developmental potential involving
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x has developmental potential involving y iff x is capable of a developmental process with output y. y may be the successor of x, or may be a different structure in the vicinity (as for example in the case of developmental induction).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: has potential to developmentally contribute to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x has potential to developmentrally contribute to y iff x developmentally contributes to y or x is capable of developmentally contributing to y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: has potential to developmentally induce
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x has potential to developmentally induce y iff x developmentally induces y or x is capable of developmentally inducing y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: has potential to develop into
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x has the potential to develop into y iff x develops into y or if x is capable of developing into y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.label: has potential to directly develop into
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000238.definition: x has potential to directly develop into y iff x directly develops into y or x is capable of directly developing into y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.label: has direct input
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.definition: p has direct input c iff c is a participant in p, c is present at the start of p, and the state of c is modified during p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.label: obsolete has direct output
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.definition: p has direct input c iff c is a participanti n p, c is present at the end of p, and c is not present at the beginning of c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.label: indirectly positively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.definition: p indirectly positively regulates q iff p is indirectly causally upstream of q and p positively regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.label: indirectly negatively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000240.definition: p indirectly negatively regulates q iff p is indirectly causally upstream of q and p negatively regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.label: causally related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.definition: relation that links two events, processes, states, or objects such that one event, process, state, or object (a cause) contributes to the production of another event, process, state, or object (an effect) where the cause is partly or wholly responsible for the effect, and the effect is partly or wholly dependent on the cause.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.label: causally upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.definition: p is causally upstream of q iff p is causally related to q, the end of p precedes the end of q, and p is not an occurrent part of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.label: immediately causally upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.definition: p is immediately causally upstream of q iff p is causally upstream of q, and the end of p is coincident with the beginning of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.label: provides input for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.definition: p provides input for q iff p is immediately causally upstream of q, and there exists some c such that p has_output c and q has_input c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.label: causally upstream of or within
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000241.definition: p is 'causally upstream or within' q iff p is causally related to q, and the end of p precedes, or is coincident with, the end of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.label: causally downstream of or within
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.definition: inverse of causally upstream of or within

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.label: involved in regulation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.definition: c involved in regulation of p if c is involved in some p' and p' regulates some p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.label: involved in positive regulation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000242.definition: c involved in regulation of p if c is involved in some p' and p' positively regulates some p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: involved in negative regulation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: c involved in regulation of p if c is involved in some p' and p' negatively regulates some p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: involved in or involved in regulation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: c involved in or regulates p if and only if either (i) c is involved in p or (ii) c is involved in regulation of p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: is active in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: c executes activity in d if and only if c enables p and p occurs_in d.  Assuming no action at a distance by gene products, if a gene product enables (is capable of) a process that occurs in some structure, it must have at least some part in that structure.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: contributes to morphology of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: p contributes to morphology of w if and only if a change in the morphology of p entails a change in the morphology of w. Examples: every skull contributes to morphology of the head which it is a part of. Counter-example: nuclei do not generally contribute to the morphology of the cell they are part of, as they are buffered by cytoplasm.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: A relationship that holds between two entities in which the processes executed by the two entities are causally connected.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: molecularly interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: An interaction relationship in which the two partners are molecular entities that directly physically interact with each other for example via a stable binding interaction or a brief interaction during which one modifies the other.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: biotically interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: An interaction relationship in which at least one of the partners is an organism and the other is either an organism or an abiotic entity with which the organism interacts.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: trophically interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: An interaction relationship in which the partners are related via a feeding relationship.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.label: preys on
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000243.definition: An interaction relationship involving a predation process, where the subject kills the target in order to eat it or to feed to siblings, offspring or group members

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: symbiotically interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: A biotic interaction in which the two organisms live together in more or less intimate association.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: commensually interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: An interaction relationship between two organisms living together in more or less intimate association in a relationship in which one benefits and the other is unaffected (GO).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: mutualistically interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: An interaction relationship between two organisms living together in more or less intimate association in a relationship in which both organisms benefit from each other (GO).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: interacts with via parasite-host interaction
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: An interaction relationship between two organisms living together in more or less intimate association in a relationship in which association is disadvantageous or destructive to one of the organisms (GO).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: A parasite-host relationship where an organism benefits at the expense of another.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: participates in a abiotic-biotic interaction with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition: A biotic interaction relationship in which one partner is an organism and the other partner is inorganic. For example, the relationship between a sponge and the substrate to which is it anchored.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: directly regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition:
The entity A, immediately upstream of the entity B, has an activity that regulates an activity performed by B. For example, A and B may be gene products and binding of B by A regulates the kinase activity of B.

A and B can be physically interacting but not necessarily. Immediately upstream means there are no intermediate entity between A and B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.label: directly negatively regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000244.definition:
The entity A, immediately upstream of the entity B, has an activity that negatively regulates an activity performed by B. 
For example, A and B may be gene products and binding of B by A negatively regulates the kinase activity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.label: directly positively regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.definition:
The entity A, immediately upstream of the entity B, has an activity that positively regulates an activity performed by B. 
For example, A and B may be gene products and binding of B by A positively regulates the kinase activity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.label: transmitted by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.definition: A relationship that holds between a disease and organism

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.label: has symptom
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.definition: A relation that holds between a disease or an organism and a phenotype

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.label: has host
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000245.definition: X 'has host' y if and only if: x is an organism, y is an organism, and x can live on the surface of or within the body of y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000246.label: helper property (not for use in curation)
provides nutrients for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000246.definition: A biotic interaction where a material entity provides nutrition for an organism.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: eats
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: A biotic interaction where one organism consumes a material entity through a type of mouth or other oral opening.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: is evidence for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition:
A relationship between a piece of evidence a and some entity b, where b is  an information content entity, material entity or process, and 
the a supports either the existence of b, or the truth value of b.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: composed primarily of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: x composed_primarily_of y if and only if more than half of the mass of x is made from y or units of the same type as y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: child nucleus of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: c is a child nucleus of d if and only if c and d are both nuclei and parts of cells c' and d', where c' is derived from d' by mitosis and the genetic material in c is a copy of the generic material in d

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: child nucleus of in hermaphrodite
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: A child nucleus relationship in which the cells are part of a hermaphroditic organism

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: child nucleus of in male
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: A child nucleus relationship in which the cells are part of a male organism

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.label: has part that occurs in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000247.definition: p has part that occurs in c if and only if there exists some p1, such that p has_part p1, and p1 occurs in c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.label: ubiquitinates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.definition: An interaction relation between x and y in which x catalyzes a reaction in which one or more ubiquitin groups are added to y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.label: relation between physical entity and a process or stage
existence starts during
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.definition: x existence starts during y if and only if the time point at which x starts is after or equivalent to the time point at which y starts and before or equivalent to the time point at which y ends. Formally: x existence starts during y iff α(x) >= α(y) & α(x) <= ω(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.label: existence starts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000248.definition: x starts ends with y if and only if the time point at which x starts is equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: x existence starts with y iff α(x) = α(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence overlaps
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x existence overlaps y if and only if either (a) the start of x is part of y or (b) the end of x is part of y. Formally: x existence starts and ends during y iff (α(x) >= α(y) & α(x) <= ω(y)) OR (ω(x) <= ω(y) & ω(x) >= α(y))

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence starts and ends during
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x exists during y if and only if: 1) the time point at which x begins to exist is after or equal to the time point at which y begins and 2) the time point at which x ceases to exist is before or equal to the point at which y ends. Formally: x existence starts and ends during y iff α(x) >= α(y) & α(x) <= ω(y) & ω(x) <= ω(y) & ω(x) >= α(y)

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence ends during
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x existence ends during y if and only if the time point at which x ends is before or equivalent to the time point at which y ends and after or equivalent to the point at which y starts. Formally: x existence ends during y iff ω(x) <= ω(y) and ω(x) >= α(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence ends with
