http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x existence ends with y if and only if the time point at which x ends is equivalent to the time point at which y ends. Formally: x existence ends with y iff ω(x) = ω(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: transformation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x transformation of y if x is the immediate transformation of y, or is linked to y through a chain of transformation relationships

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: immediate transformation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x immediate transformation of y iff x immediately succeeds y temporally at a time boundary t, and all of the matter present in x at t is present in y at t, and all the matter in y at t is present in x at t

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence starts during or after
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x existence starts during or after y if and only if the time point at which x starts is after or equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: x existence starts during or after y iff α (x) >= α (y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.label: existence ends during or before
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000249.definition: x existence ends during or before y if and only if the time point at which x ends is before or equivalent to the time point at which y ends.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: causal agent in process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: A relationship between a material entity and a process where the material entity has some causal role that influences the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: causal relation between processes
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: p is causally related to q if and only if p or any part of p and q or any part of q are linked by a chain of events where each event pair is one where the execution of p influences the execution of q. p may be upstream, downstream, part of, or a container of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: towards
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: q towards e2 if and only if q is a relational quality such that q inheres-in some e, and e != e2 and q is dependent on e2

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: has intermediate
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: p has intermediate c if and only if p has parts p1, p2 and p1 has output c, and p2 has input c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: determined by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: s determined by f if and only if s is a type of system, and f is a material entity that is part of s, such that f exerts a strong causal influence on the functioning of s, and the removal of f would cause the collapse of s.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.label: determined by part of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000250.definition: s 'determined by part of' w if and only if there exists some f such that (1) s 'determined by' f and (2) f part_of w, or f=w.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: transcribed from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: x is transcribed from y if and only if x is synthesized from template y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: ribosomal translation of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: x is the ribosomal translation of y if and only if a ribosome reads x through a series of triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activities (GO:0030533) and produces y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: sequentially related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: A relation that holds between two entities that have the property of being sequences or having sequences.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: sequentially adjacent to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: x is sequentially adjacent to y iff x and y do not overlap and if there are no base units intervening between x and y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: has start sequence
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: x has start sequence y if the start of x is identical to the start of y, and x has y as a subsequence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.label: has end sequence
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000251.definition: x has end sequence y if the end of x is identical to the end of y, and x has y as a subsequence

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: is consecutive sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x is a consecutive sequence of y iff x has subsequence y, and all the parts of x are made of zero or more repetitions of y or sequences as the same type as y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: is sequentially aligned with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x is sequentially aligned with if a significant portion bases of x and y correspond in terms of their base type and their relative ordering

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: bounds sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x bounds the sequence of y iff the upstream-most part of x is upstream of or coincident with the upstream-most part of y, and the downstream-most part of x is downstream of or coincident with the downstream-most part of y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: has subsequence
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x has subsequence y iff all of the sequence parts of y are sequence parts of x

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: overlaps sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x overlaps the sequence of y if and only if x has a subsequence z and z is a subsequence of y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: does not overlap sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x does not overlap the sequence of y if and only if there is no z such that x has a subsequence z and z is a subsequence of y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: is upstream of sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: inverse of downstream of sequence of

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.label: is downstream of sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000252.definition: x is downstream of the sequence of y iff either (1) x and y have sequence units, and all units of x are downstream of all units of y, or (2) x and y are sequence units, and x is either immediately downstream of y, or transitively downstream of y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000253.label: is immediately downstream of sequence of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000253.definition: x is immediately downstream of the sequence of y iff either (1) x and y have sequence units, and all units of x are downstream of all units of y, and x is sequentially adjacent to y, or (2) x and y are sequence units, in which case the immediately downstream relation is primitive and defined by context: for DNA bases, y would be adjacent and 5' to y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000253.label: is immediately upstream of sequence of

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.label: has skeleton
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.definition: A relation between a segment or subdivision of an organism and the maximal subdivision of material entities that provides structural support for that segment or subdivision.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.label: results in ending of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.definition: p results in the end of s if p results in a change of state in s whereby s either ceases to exist, or s becomes functionally impaired or s has its fate committed such that it is put on a path to be degraded.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.label: hyperparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.definition: x is a hyperparasite of y iff x is a parasite of a parasite of the target organism y

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.label: allelopath of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.definition: A relationship between organisms where one organism is influenced by the biochemicals produced by another.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.label: has pathogen
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000255.definition: A host interaction where the smaller of the two members of a symbiosis causes a disease in the larger member

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.label: results in movement of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.definition: Holds between p and c when p is locomotion process and the outcome of this process is the change of location of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.label: causally influences
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.definition: The entity or characteristic A is causally upstream of the entity or characteristic B, A having an effect on B. An entity corresponds to any biological type of entity as long as a mass is measurable. A characteristic corresponds to a particular specificity of an entity (e.g., phenotype, shape, size).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.label: biomechanically related to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.definition: A relation that holds between elements of a musculoskeletal system or its analogs.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.label: has muscle antagonist
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000256.definition: m1 has_muscle_antagonist m2 iff m1 has_muscle_insertion s, m2 has_muscle_insection s, m1 acts in opposition to m2, and m2 is responsible for returning the structure to its initial position.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.label: conduit for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.definition: x is a conduit for y iff y overlaps through the lumen_of of x, and y has parts on either side of the lumen of x.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.label: lumen of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.definition: x lumen_of y iff x is the space or substance that is part of y and does not cross any of the inner membranes or boundaries of y that is maximal with respect to the volume of the convex hull.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.label: luminal space of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.definition: s is luminal space of x iff s is lumen_of x and s is an immaterial entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.label: has modifier
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.definition: A relation that holds between an attribute or a qualifier and another attribute.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.label: participates in a biotic-biotic interaction with
directly regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000257.definition: p directly regulates q iff p is immediately causally upstream of q and p regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.label: existence starts at end of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.definition: holds between x and y if and only if the time point at which x starts is equivalent to the time point at which y ends. Formally: iff α(x) = ω(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.label: has part structure that is capable of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.definition: s 'has part structure that is capable of' p if and only if there exists some part x such that s 'has part' x and x 'capable of' p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.label: results in breakdown of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.definition: p results in breakdown of c if and only if the execution of p leads to c no longer being present at the end of p

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.label: results in catabolism of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000258.definition: p results in catabolism of c if and only if p is a catabolic process, and the execution of p results in c being broken into smaller parts with energy being released.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: results in organization of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: p results in organization of c iff p results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: existence ends at start of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: holds between x and y if and only if the time point at which x ends is equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: iff ω(x) = α(y).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: causal relation between material entity and a process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: A relationship that holds between a material entity and a process in which causality is involved, with either the material entity or some part of the material entity exerting some influence over the process, or the process influencing some aspect of the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: capable of regulating
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: Holds between c and p if and only if c is capable of some activity a, and a regulates p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: capable of negatively regulating
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: Holds between c and p if and only if c is capable of some activity a, and a negatively regulates p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: capable of positively regulating
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: Holds between c and p if and only if c is capable of some activity a, and a positively regulates p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.label: capable of inhibiting or preventing pathological process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000259.definition: Holds between a material entity c and a pathological process p if and only if c is capable of some activity a, where a inhibits p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.label: capable of upregulating or causing pathological process
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.definition: Holds between a material entity c and a pathological process p if and only if c is capable of some activity a, where a negatively regulates p.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.label: is substance that treats
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.definition: c is a substance that treats d if c is a material entity (such as a small molecule or compound) and d is a pathological process, phenotype or disease, and c is capable of some activity that negative regulates or decreases the magnitude of d.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.label: is marker for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.definition: c is marker for d iff the presence or occurrence of d is correlated with the presence of occurrence of c, and the observation of c is used to infer the presence or occurrence of d. Note that this does not imply that c and d are in a direct causal relationship, as it may be the case that there is a third entity e that stands in a direct causal relationship with c and d.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.label: obsolete related via dependence to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000260.definition: A relationship that holds between two entities, where the relationship holds based on the presence or absence of statistical dependence relationship. The entities may be statistical variables, or they may be other kinds of entities such as diseases, chemical entities or processes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000261.label: correlated with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000261.definition: A relationship that holds between two entities, where the entities exhibit a statistical dependence relationship. The entities may be statistical variables, or they may be other kinds of entities such as diseases, chemical entities or processes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000261.label: is evidence with support from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000261.definition: A relationship between a piece of evidence and an entity that plays a role in supporting that evidence.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000261.label: related via evidence or inference to

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000262.label: directly positively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000262.definition: p directly positively regulates q iff p is immediately causally upstream of q, and p positively regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.label: directly negatively regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.definition: p directly negatively regulates q iff p is immediately causally upstream of q, and p negatively regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.label: ectoparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.definition: A sub-relation of parasite-of in which the parasite lives on or in the integumental system of the host

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.label: mesoparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.definition: A sub-relation of parasite-of in which the parasite is partially an endoparasite and partially an ectoparasite

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.label: intercellular endoparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000263.definition: A sub-relation of endoparasite-of in which the parasite inhabits the spaces between host cells.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000264.label: intracellular endoparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000264.definition: A sub-relation of endoparasite-of in which the parasite inhabits host cells.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.label: co-roosts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.definition: Two or more individuals sharing the same roost site (cave, mine, tree or tree hollow, animal burrow, leaf tent, rock crack, space in man-made structure, etc.). Individuals that are sharing a communal roost may be said to be co-roosting. The roost may be either a day roost where the individuals rest during daytime hours, or a night roost where individuals roost to feed, groom, or rest in between flights and/or foraging bouts.  Communal roosting as thus defined is an umbrella term within which different specialized types -- which are not mutually exclusive -- may be recognized based on taxonomy and the temporal and spatial relationships of the individuals that are co-roosting.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.label: reservoir host of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.definition: A relation between a host organism and a hosted organism in which the hosted organism naturally occurs in an indefinitely maintained reservoir provided by the host.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.label: ectomycorrhizal host of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.definition: x is an ectomycorrhizal host of y if and only if x is a plant (Plantae) whose roots form an intercellular interface (aka Hartig net) with fungus (Fungi) y. This interface consists of highly branched hyphae forming a latticework between epidermal and cortical root cells.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.label: arbuscular mycorrhizal host of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.definition: x is an arbuscular mycorrhizal host of y if and only if x is a vascular plant (Plantae) whose cortical cells of the roots are penetrated by fungus (Fungi) y and form arbuscules.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.label: has arbuscular mycorrhizal host
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000280.definition: inverse of arbuscular mycorrhizal host of

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.label: produces
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.definition: a produces b if some process that occurs_in a has_output b, where a and b are material entities. Examples: hybridoma cell line produces monoclonal antibody reagent; chondroblast produces avascular GAG-rich matrix.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.label: produced by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.definition: a produced_by b iff some process that occurs_in b has_output a.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.label: represses expression of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.definition: Holds between entity A (a transcription factor) and a nucleic acid B if and only if A down-regulates the expression of B. The nucleic acid can be a gene or an mRNA.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.label: increases expression of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000300.definition: Holds between entity A (a transcription factor) and nucleic acid B if and only if A up-regulates the expression of B. The nucleic acid can be a gene or mRNA.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: has role in modeling
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relation between a biological, experimental, or computational artifact and an entity it is used to study, in virtue of its replicating or approximating features of the studied entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: causes or contributes to condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the entity has some causal or contributing role that influences the condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: causes condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the entity has some causal role for the condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: contributes to condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the entity has some contributing role that influences the condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: contributes to severity of condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the entity influences the severity with which a condition manifests in an individual.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: contributes to frequency of condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the entity influences the frequency of the condition in a population.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: ameliorates condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a genotype, genetic variation, chemical, or environmental exposure) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the presence of the entity reduces or eliminates some or all aspects of the condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: correlated with condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity and a condition (phenotype or disease) with which it exhibits a statistical dependence relationship.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.label: exacerbates condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000330.definition: A relationship between an entity (e.g. a chemical, environmental exposure, or some form of genetic variation) and a condition (a phenotype or disease), where the presence of the entity worsens some or all aspects of the condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000331.label: condition ameliorated by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000331.definition: A relationship between a condition (a phenotype or disease) and an entity (e.g. a chemical, environmental exposure, or some form of genetic variation) where some or all aspects of the condition are reduced or eliminated by the presence of the entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000331.label: condition exacerbated by
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000331.definition: A relationship between a condition (a phenotype or disease) and an entity (e.g. a chemical, environmental exposure, or some form of genetic variation) where some or all aspects of the condition are worsened by the presence of the entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.label: has material basis in gain of function germline mutation in
has material basis in loss of function germline mutation in
has material basis in germline mutation in
has material basis in somatic mutation in
has partial material basis in germline mutation in
has primary input or output
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.definition: p 'has primary input ot output' c iff either (a) p 'has primary input' c or (b) p 'has primary output' c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.label: has primary output
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.definition: p has primary output c if (a) p has output c and (b) the goal of process is to modify, produce, or transform c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.label: has primary input
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000400.definition: p has primary input c if (a) p has input c and (b) the goal of process is to modify, consume, or transform c.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal gain of function germline mutation of in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene in a germ cell provides a new function of the corresponding product and that is sufficient to produce the condition and that can be passed on to offspring[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal loss of function germline mutation of in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene in a germ cell impairs the function of the corresponding product and that is sufficient to produce the condition and that can be passed on to offspring[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal germline mutation in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene is sufficient to produce the condition and that can be passed on to offspring[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal somatic mutation in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene is sufficient to produce the condition but that cannot be passed on to offspring[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal susceptibility factor for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene predisposes to the development of a condition  and that is necessary but not sufficient to develop the condition[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.label: is causal germline mutation partially giving rise to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000401.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a mutation in this gene partially contributes to the presentation of this condition[modified from orphanet].

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has basis in dysfunction of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relation that holds between the disease and a material entity where the physical basis of the disease is a disorder of that material entity that affects its function.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has basis in disruption of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relation that holds between the disease and a process where the physical basis of the disease disrupts execution of a key biological process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has basis in feature
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relation that holds between the disease and a feature (a phenotype or other disease) where the physical basis of the disease is the feature.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: causal relationship with disease as subject
disease causes disruption of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relationship between a disease and a process where the disease process disrupts the execution of the process.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has location
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relationship between a disease and an anatomical entity where the disease has one or more features that are located in that entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has inflammation site
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relationship between a disease and an anatomical entity where the disease is triggered by an inflammatory response to stimuli occurring in the anatomical entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: realized in response to stimulus
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relationship between a realizable entity R (e.g. function or disposition) and a material entity M where R is realized in response to a process that has an input stimulus of M.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.label: disease has feature
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000402.definition: A relationship between a disease and some feature of that disease, where the feature is either a phenotype or an isolated disease.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.label: disease arises from alteration in structure
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.definition: A relationship between a disease and an anatomical structure where the material basis of the disease is some pathological change in the structure. Anatomical structure includes cellular and sub-cellular entities, such as chromosome and organelles.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.label: enables subfunction
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.definition: Holds between an entity and an process P where the entity enables some larger compound process, and that larger process has-part P.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.label: acts upstream of or within, positive effect
acts upstream of or within, negative effect
acts upstream of, positive effect
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.definition: c 'acts upstream of, positive effect' p if c is enables f, and f is causally upstream of p, and the direction of f is positive

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.label: acts upstream of, negative effect
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000403.definition: c 'acts upstream of, negative effect' p if c is enables f, and f is causally upstream of p, and the direction of f is negative

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000404.label: causally upstream of or within, negative effect
causally upstream of or within, positive effect

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000700.label: has driver
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000700.definition: A relation between two entities, in which one of the entities is any natural or human-influenced factor that directly or indirectly causes a change in the other entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000700.label: has disease driver
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000700.definition: A relation between an entity and a disease of a host, in which the entity is not part of the host itself, and the condition results in pathological processes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: epiphyte of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: An interaction relationship wherein a plant or algae is living on the outside surface of another plant.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: kleptoparasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: A sub-relation of parasite of in which a parasite steals resources from another organism, usually food or nest material

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: creates habitat for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: An interaction relationship wherein one organism creates a structure or environment that is lived in by another organism.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: ecologically co-occurs with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: An interaction relationship describing organisms that often occur together at the same time and space or in the same environment.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: lays eggs on
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: An interaction relationship in which organism a lays eggs on the outside surface of organism b. Organism b is neither helped nor harmed in the process of egg laying or incubation.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.label: has roost
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000850.definition: x 'has roost' y if and only if: x is an organism, y is a habitat, and y can support rest behaviors x.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000851.label: symbiotrophically interacts with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000851.definition: A trophic interaction in which one organism acquires nutrients through a symbiotic relationship with another organism

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000851.label: trophic parasite of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000851.definition: A symbiotrophic interaction in which one organism acquires nutrients through a parasitic relationship with another organism

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: has substance added
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: "has substance added" is a relation existing between a (physical) entity and a substance in which the entity has had the substance added to it at some point in time.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: has substance removed
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: "has substance removed" is a relation existing between two physical entities in which the first entity has had the second entity (a substance) removed from it at some point in time.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: immersed in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: "immersed in" is a relation between a (physical) entity and a fluid substance in which the entity is wholely or substantially surrounded by the substance.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: has consumer
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: 'has consumer' is a relation between a material entity and an organism in which the former can normally be digested or otherwise absorbed by the latter without immediate or persistent ill effect.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: has primary substance added
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: 'has primary substance added' indicates that an entity has had the given substance added to it in a proportion greater than any other added substance.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.label: assay measures characteristic
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000900.definition: A relation between an assay and a characteristic, in which the assay generates a data item which is a measure of a characteristic.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000950.label: realized in response to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_000950.definition: r 'realized in response to' s iff, r is a realizable (e.g. a plant trait such as responsivity to drought), s is an environmental stimulus (a process), and s directly causes the realization of r.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001000.label: generically depends on
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001000.definition: A generically dependent continuant *b* generically depends on an independent continuant *c* at time *t* means: there inheres in *c* a specifically deendent continuant which concretizes *b* at *t*.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001000.label: is carrier of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001000.definition: *b* is carrier of *c* at time *t* if and only if *c* *g-depends on* *b* at *t*

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition: The entity A has an activity that regulates an activity of the entity B. For example, A and B are gene products where the catalytic activity of A regulates the kinase activity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition: The entity A has an activity that regulates the quantity or abundance or concentration of the entity B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: indirectly regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition: The entity A is not immediately upstream of the entity B but A has an activity that regulates an activity performed by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: decreases by repression quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition:
The entity A has an activity that down-regulates by repression the quantity of B. The down-regulation is due to A having an effect on an intermediate entity (typically a DNA or mRNA element) which can produce B.

For example, protein A (transcription factor) indirectly decreases by repression the quantity of protein B (gene product) if and only if A negatively regulates the process of transcription or translation of a nucleic acid element that produces B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: increases by expression quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition:
The entity A has an activity that up-regulates by expression the quantity of B. The up-regulation is due to A having an effect on an intermediate entity (typically a DNA or mRNA element) which can produce B.

For example, protein A (transcription factor) indirectly increases by expression the quantity of protein B (gene product) if and only if A positively regulates the process of transcription or translation of a nucleic acid element that produces B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.label: directly positively regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001100.definition: The entity A has an activity that directly positively regulates the quantity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.label: directly negatively regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.definition: The entity A has an activity that directly negatively regulates the quantity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.label: indirectly positively regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.definition: The entity A is not immediately upstream of the entity B and has an activity that up-regulates an activity performed by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.label: destabilizes quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.definition: An entity A directly interacts with B and A has an activity that decreases the amount of an entity B by degradating it.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.label: stabilizes quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.definition: An entity A physically interacts with B and A has an activity that increases the amount of an entity B by stabilizing it.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.label: indirectly negatively regulates activity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001101.definition: The entity A is not immediately upstream of the entity B and has an activity that down-regulates an activity performed by B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.label: directly regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.definition: The entity A, immediately upstream of B, has an activity that directly regulates the quantity of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.label: indirectly regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.definition: The entity A is not immediately upstream of the entity B, but A has an activity that regulates the quantity or abundance or concentration of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.label: indirectly negatively regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.definition: The entity A does not physically interact with the entity B, and A has an activity that down-regulates the quantity or abundance or concentration of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.label: indirectly positively regulates quantity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001102.definition: The entity A does not physically interact with the entity B, and A has an activity that up-regulates the quantity or abundance or concentration of B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: has small molecule regulator
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a process and a continuant, in which the process is regulated by the small molecule continuant

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: has small molecule activator
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a process and a continuant, in which the process is activated by the small molecule continuant

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: has small molecule inhibitor
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a process and a continuant, in which the process is inhibited by the small molecule continuant

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: acts on population of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: p acts on population of c iff c' is a collection, has members of type c, and p has participant c

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: is small molecule regulator of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a continuant and a process, in which the continuant is a small molecule that regulates the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: is small molecule activator of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a continuant and a process, in which the continuant is a small molecule that activates the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: is small molecule inhibitor of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: a relation between a continuant and a process, in which the continuant is a small molecule that inhibits the process

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: results in adhesion of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: The relationship that links anatomical entities with a process that results in the adhesion of two or more entities via the non-covalent interaction of molecules expressed in, located in, and/or adjacent to, those entities.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.label: constitutively upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001200.definition: p is constitutively upstream of q iff p is causally upstream of q, p is required for execution of q or a part of q, and the execution of p is approximately constant.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.label: removes input for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.definition: p removes input for q iff p is causally upstream of q, there exists some c such that p has_input c and q has_input c, p reduces the levels of c, and c is rate limiting for execution of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.label: indirectly causally upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.definition: p is indirectly causally upstream of q iff p is causally upstream of q and there exists some process r such that p is causally upstream of r and r is causally upstream of q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.label: indirectly regulates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.definition: p indirectly regulates q iff p is indirectly causally upstream of q and p regulates q.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.label: positively regulates in another organism
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.definition: x 'positively regulates in other organism' y if and only if: (x is the realization of a function to increase the frequency, rate or extent of y) AND (the agents of x are produced by organism o1 and the agents of y are produced by organism o2).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.label: negatively regulates in another organism
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001201.definition: x 'negatively regulates in other organism' y if and only if: (x is the realization of a function to reduce the frequency, rate or extent of y) AND (the agents of x are produced by organism o1 and the agents of y are produced by organism o2).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: has synaptic IO in region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number of input and/or output synapses in that region.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: receives synaptic input in region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number of input synapses in that region.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: sends synaptic output to region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number of output synapses in that region.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: has synaptic IO throughout
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number of input and/or output synapses distributed throughout that region (rather than confined to a subregion).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: receives synaptic input throughout
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number of input synapses distributed throughout that region (rather than confined to a subregion).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: sends synaptic output throughout
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where the neuron has a functionally relevant number output synapses distributed throughout that region (rather than confined to a subregion).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: has sensory dendrite in
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: Relation between a sensory neuron and some structure in which it receives sensory input via a sensory dendrite.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: receives synaptic input from neuron
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between an anatomical structure (including cells) and a neuron that has a functionally relevant number of chemical synapses to it.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.label: sends synaptic output to cell
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001300.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a cell that it has a functionally relevant number of chemical synapses to.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001301.label: synapses restricted to region
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001301.definition: A relationship between a neuron and a region, where all of the functionally relevant input and output synapses are in that region.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001400.label: disease has infectious agent
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001400.definition: A relationship between a disease and an infectious agent where the material basis of the disease is an infection with some infectious agent.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: has exemplar data
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: A relation between a material entity and some data in which the data is taken as exemplifying the material entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: subcluster of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: A relation between a group and another group it is part of but does not fully constitute.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: has characterizing marker set
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: A relation that applies between a cell type and a set of markers that can be used to uniquely identify that cell type.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: different in magnitude relative to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: q1 different_in_magnitude_relative_to q2 if and only if magnitude(q1) NOT =~ magnitude(q2). Here, magnitude(q) is a function that maps a quality to a unit-invariant scale.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: increased in magnitude relative to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: q1 increased_in_magnitude_relative_to q2 if and only if magnitude(q1) > magnitude(q2). Here, magnitude(q) is a function that maps a quality to a unit-invariant scale.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: decreased in magnitude relative to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: q1 decreased_in_magnitude_relative_to q2 if and only if magnitude(q1) < magnitude(q2). Here, magnitude(q) is a function that maps a quality to a unit-invariant scale.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.label: similar in magnitude relative to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001500.definition: q1 similar_in_magnitude_relative_to q2 if and only if magnitude(q1) =~ magnitude(q2). Here, magnitude(q) is a function that maps a quality to a unit-invariant scale.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.label: has cross section
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.definition: s3 has_cross_section s3 if and only if : there exists some 2d plane that intersects the bearer of s3, and the impression of s3 upon that plane has shape quality s2.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.label: reciprocal of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.definition: q1 reciprocal_of q2 if and only if : q1 and q2 are relational qualities and a phenotype e q1 e2 mutually implies a phenotype e2 q2 e.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.label: has high plasma membrane amount
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.definition: A relation between a cell and molecule or complex such that every instance of the cell has a high number of instances of that molecule expressed on the cell surface.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.label: has low plasma membrane amount
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001501.definition: A relation between a cell and molecule or complex such that every instance of the cell has a low number of instances of that molecule expressed on the cell surface.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001600.label: has disease
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001600.definition: A relationship that holds between an organism and a disease. Here a disease is construed broadly as a disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001600.label: has exposure medium
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001600.definition: X has exposure medium Y if X is an exposure event (process), Y is a material entity, and the stimulus for X is transmitted or carried in Y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: device utilizes material
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: X device utilizes material Y means X and Y are material entities, and X is capable of some process P that has input Y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: information specifies
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A relation between information and an entity such that the information serves as a rule or guide if the entity is an occurrent, or the information serves as a model if the entity is a continuant.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: positively correlated with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A relation between entities in which one increases or decreases as the other does the same.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: negatively correlated with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A relation between entities in which one increases as the other decreases.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: contains measured amount
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A relation between a container and measurement datum that specifies the actual amount of material in the container.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: has maximum capacity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A relation that relates a container to a measurement datum that specifies the maximum capacity of the container. Capacity can refer to either weight or volume.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.label: owns
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001700.definition: A primitive relation that holds between entities x and y in which y is at x's full disposal.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001750.label: collected during
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001750.definition: A relation between a material entity and an occurrent in which the material entity is collected during the existence of the occurrent.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001800.label: is myristoyltransferase activity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001800.definition: Helper relation for OWL definition of RO:0018002 myristoylates

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001800.label: myristoylates
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001800.definition: A molecularly-interacts-with relationship between two entities, where the subject catalyzes a myristoylation activity that takes the object as input

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.label: is agonist of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.definition: a relation between a ligand (material entity) and a receptor (material entity) that implies the binding of the ligand to the receptor activates some activity of the receptor

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.label: is inverse agonist of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.definition: a relation between a ligand (material entity) and a receptor (material entity) that implies the binding of the ligand to the receptor inhibits some activity of the receptor to below basal level

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.label: is antagonist of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001802.definition: a relation between a ligand (material entity) and a receptor (material entity) that implies the binding of the ligand to the receptor reduces some activity of the receptor to basal level

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is direct conjugate base of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition: A is a direct conjugate base of B if and only if A is chemical entity that is a Brønsted–Lowry Base (i.e., can receive a proton) and by receiving a particular proton transforms it into B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is direct conjugate acid of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition: A is a direct conjugate acid of B if and only if A is chemical entity that is a Brønsted–Lowry Acid (i.e., can give up a proton) and by removing a particular proton transforms it into B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is deprotonated form of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
A is a deprotonated form of B if and only if A is chemical entity that is a Brønsted–Lowry Base (i.e., can receive a proton) and by adding some nonzero number of protons transforms it into B.

This is a transitive relationship and follows this design pattern: https://oborel.github.io/obo-relations/direct-and-indirect-relations.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is protonated form of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
A is a protonated form of B if and only if A is chemical entity that is a Brønsted–Lowry Acid (i.e., can give up a proton) and by removing some nonzero number of protons transforms it into B.

This is a transitive relationship and follows this design pattern: https://oborel.github.io/obo-relations/direct-and-indirect-relations.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is matched small molecular pair with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
A and B are a matched small molecular pair (MMP) if their chemical structures define by a single, relatively small, well-defined structural modification.

While this is normally called "matched molecular pair" in the cheminformatics literaturel, it is labeled as "matched small molecular pair" so as to reduce confusion with peptides and other macromolecules, which are also referenced as "molecules" in some contexts.

This relationship is symmetric, meaning if A is a MMP with B iff B is a MMP with A.

This relationship is not transitive, meaning that A is a MMP with B and B is a MMP with C, then A is not necessarily an MMP with C.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is tautomer of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
Two chemicals are tautomers if they can be readily interconverted.

This commonly refers to prototropy in which a hydrogen's position is changed, such as between ketones and enols. This is also often observed in heterocyclic rings, e.g., ones containing nitrogens and/or have aryl functional groups containing heteroatoms.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is substitutent group from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition: Group A is a substituent group from Chemical B if A represents the functional part of A and includes information about where it is connected. A is not itself a chemical with a fully formed chemical graph, but is rather a partial graph with one or more connection points that can be used to attach to another chemical graph, typically as a functionalization.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: has functional parent
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
Chemical A has functional parent Chemical B if there is chemical transformation through which chemical B can be produced from chemical A. 

For example, the relationship between a salt and a freebased compound is a "has functional parent" relationship.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.label: is enantiomer of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001803.definition:
Chemicals A and B are enantiomers if they share the same molecular graph except the change of the configuration of substituents around exactly one chiral center.

A chemical with no chiral centers can not have an enantiomer. A chemical with multiple chiral centers can have multiple enantiomers, but its enantiomers are not themselves enantiomers (they are diastereomers).

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001804.label: has parent hydride
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001804.definition: Chemical A has parent hydride Chemical B if there exists a molecular graphical transformation where functional groups on A are replaced with hydrogens in order to yield B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001804.label: has gene product that enables
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001804.definition: a relationship between a gene and the molecular function or activity enabled by the gene product (e.g., protein) that it encodes

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: regulates characteristic
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relationship that holds between a process and a characteristic in which process (P) regulates characteristic (C) iff: P results in the existence of C OR affects the intensity or magnitude of C.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: positively regulates characteristic
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relationship that holds between a process and a characteristic in which process (P) positively regulates characteristic (C) iff: P results in an increase in the intensity or magnitude of C.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: negatively regulates characteristic
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relationship that holds between a process and a characteristic in which process (P) negatively regulates characteristic (C) iff: P results in a decrease in the intensity or magnitude of C.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: has substitutable entity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: Relates one individual to another which is capable of standing in for the first individual in its other relations to other individuals.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: immediately constitutively upstream of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: p is immediately constitutively upstream of q iff p is immediately causally upstream of q, p is required for execution of q or a part of q, and the execution of p is approximately constant.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: has active component
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relation that holds between a collection of items, x, and one of its constituent members, y, such that execution of the primary activity associated with x is attributable to the activity of y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: has accessory component
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relation that holds between a collection of items, x, and one of its constituent members, y, such that the activity of y is necessary for execution of the primary activity associated with x but y does not execute the primary activity itself.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: is active component of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relation that holds between y, a constituent member of a collection of items, x, such that the activity of y is responsible for execution of the primary activity attributed to x.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.label: is accessory component of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001900.definition: A relation that holds between y, a constituent member of a collection of items, x, such that the activity of y is necessary for the primary activity attributed to x but y does not execute the primary activity itself.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001950.label: confers susceptibility to condition
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_001950.definition: Relates a gene to condition, such that a variation in this gene predisposes to the development of a condition.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.label: vessel supplies blood to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.definition: x vessel supplies blood to y if and only if x is a vessel that supplies blood directly or indirectly to an anatomical structure y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.label: vessel drains blood from
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.definition: x vessel drains blood from y if and only if x is a vessel that drains blood directly or indirectly from an anatomical structure y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.label: directly supplies and drains
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.definition: x directly supplies and drains y if and only if x is a capillary, y is an anatomical entity, and x directly supplies and drains y.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.label: is neuron
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.definition: This property only applies to neurons

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.label: is anatomical entity
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002010.definition: This property only applies to anatomical entities.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002020.label: has numerator
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002020.definition: A relationship between a ratio or proportion and its dividend.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002020.label: has denominator
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002020.definition: A relationship between a ratio or proportion and its divisor.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.label: provides clinical information for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and a disease or condition of clinical interest 'd', where the presence or occurrence of 'b' provides clinical information about 'd'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.label: diagnostic for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and a disease or condition of clinical interest 'd', where the presence or occurrence of 'b' is used to infer the presence or occurrence of 'd' or determine its subtype.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.label: monitors status of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.definition: A relationship between a serially-measured biomarker 'b' and a disease or condition of clinical interest 'd', where 'b' is used to infer the status of 'd'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.label: indicates response to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002032.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where 'b' is used to show that a biological response to 'e' has occurred.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: predicts effect of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where 'b' is used to identify individuals who are likely to experience a favorable or unfavorable effect from exposure to 'e'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: prognostic for
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and a disease or condition of clinical interest 'd', where the presence or occurrence of 'b' is used to infer the likelihood of a clinical event, disease recurrence or progression in patients who have 'd'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: assesses toxicity of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where 'b' is used to indicate the likelihood, presence, or extent of toxicity as an adverse effect of exposure to 'e'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: indicates risk of developing
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and a disease or condition of clinical interest 'd', where the presence or occurrence of 'b' is used to infer the potential for developing 'd' in an individual that currently does not have 'd'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: indicates clinical effect of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where the effect of exposure to 'e' is correlated with the presence or occurrence of 'b', and the observation of 'b' is used to infer exposure to 'e'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: monitors effect of
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a serially-measured biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where 'b' is used to provide evidence of a biological effect of 'e'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: monitors exposure to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relationship between a serially-measured biomarker 'b' and an exposure agent 'e', where 'b' is used to provide evidence of exposure to 'e'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: has constituent monomer
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relation that holds between a polymer and its constituent monomers. P has_constituent_monomer 'm' if and only if P has_component multiple instances of 'm' and each instance of 'm' is covalently attached to another instance of 'm'.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: covalently bound to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relation that holds between two distinct chemical entities that are held in close proximity to each other specifically via the force of covalent interactions.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.label: non-covalently bound to
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_002033.definition: A relation that holds between two distinct chemical entities that are held in close proximity to each other specifically via the force of non-covalent interactions.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_004003.label: disease relationship
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_004003.definition: This relation groups  relations between diseases and any other kind of entity.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_004003.label: results in changes to anatomical or cellular structure
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_004003.definition: p has anatomical participant c iff p has participant c, and c is an anatomical entity

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in similarity relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Relation between biological objects that resemble or are related to each other sufficiently to warrant a comparison.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Similarity that results from common evolutionary origin.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in homoplasy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Similarity that results from independent evolution.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in homocracy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Similarity that is characterized by the organization of anatomical structures through the expression of homologous or identical patterning genes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in convergence relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homoplasy that involves different underlying mechanisms or structures.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in parallelism relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homoplasy that involves homologous underlying mechanisms or structures.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in structural homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homology that is defined by similarity with regard to selected structural parameters.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in historical homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homology that is defined by common descent.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in biological homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homology that is defined by sharing of a set of developmental constraints, caused by locally acting self-regulatory mechanisms of differentiation, between individualized parts of the phenotype.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in reversal relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homoplasy that involves phenotypes similar to those seen in ancestors within the lineage.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in syntenic homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Structural homology that is detected by similarity in content and organization between chromosomes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves genes that diverged after a duplication event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in syntenic paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that involves sets of syntenic blocks.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in syntenic orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Syntenic homology that involves chromosomes of different species.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in partial homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Structural homology that involves complex structures from which only a fraction of the elements that can be isolated are separately homologous.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in protein structural homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Structural homology that is detected at the level of the 3D protein structure, but maybe not at the level of the amino acid sequence.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in non functional homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Structural homology that involves a pseudogenic feature and its functional ancestor.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves genes that diverged after a speciation event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in xenology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that is characterized by an interspecies (horizontal) transfer since the common ancestor.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in 1 to 1 homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves two members sharing no other homologs in the lineages considered.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in 1 to 1 orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Orthology that involves two genes that did not experience any duplication after the speciation event that created them.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in ohnology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that results from a whole genome duplication event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in in-paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that results from a lineage-specific duplication subsequent to a given speciation event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in out-paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that results from a duplication preceding a given speciation event.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in pro-orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: 1:many orthology that involves a gene in species A and one of its ortholog in species B, when duplications more recent than the species split have occurred in species B but not in species A.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in semi-orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: 1:many orthology that involves a gene in species A and its ortholog in species B, when duplications more recent than the species split have occurred in species A but not in species B.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in serial homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Iterative homology that involves structures arranged along the main body axis.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in heterochronous homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Biological homology that is characterized by changes, over evolutionary time, in the rate or timing of developmental events of homologous structures.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in paedomorphorsis relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Heterochronous homology that is produced by a retention in adults of a species of traits previously seen only in juveniles.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in peramorphosis relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Heterochronous homology that is produced by a maturation of individuals of a species past adulthood, which take on hitherto unseen traits.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in progenesis relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paedomorphosis that is produced by precocious sexual maturation of an organism still in a morphologically juvenile stage.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in neoteny relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paedomorphosis that is produced by a retardation of somatic development.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in mimicry relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Convergence that results from co-evolution usually involving an evolutionary arms race.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in 1 to many orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Orthology that involves two genes when duplications more recent than the species split have occurred in one species but not the other.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in many to many homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves two members of a larger set of homologs.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in 1 to many homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves a structure that has no other homologs in the species in which it is defined, and several homologous structures in another species.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in apomorphy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that is based on recent shared ancestry, characterizing a monophyletic group.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in plesiomorphy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that is based on distant shared ancestry.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in deep homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Homocracy that involves morphologically and phylogenetically disparate structures that are the result of parallel evolution.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in hemiplasy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that is characterized by topological discordance between a gene tree and a species tree attributable to the phylogenetic sorting of genetic polymorphisms across successive nodes in a species tree.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in gametology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves not recombining and subsequently differentiated sex chromosomes.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in chromosomal homology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Historical homology that involves the chromosomes able to pair (synapse) during meiosis.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in many to many orthology relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Orthology that involves two genes that experienced duplications more recent than the species split that created them.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in within-species paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that involves genes from the same species.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in between-species paralogy relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paralogy that involves genes from different species.

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.label: in postdisplacement relationship with
http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_HOM000.definition: Paedomorphosis that is produced by delayed growth of immature structures into the adult form.
